generic.Defined scope/population: All new broker submissions registered today that have no acknowledgment activity yet.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions received in the current business day, timed from the inbound message header.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acknowledgment carries submission reference, named insured, requested effective date and turnaround dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of acknowledgments sent equals count of submissions registered in the same intake window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent acknowledgment copy filed to the submission correspondence folder with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late or bounced acknowledgments logged with cause and the resend outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: All acknowledgment activities raised against submissions registered in the review week.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any acknowledgment is sent more than 4 hours after the submission received timestamp.
generic.Exception handling path: Bounced or late acknowledgments go to the New Business Case Manager for resend and root cause.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Note states reference, insured, effective date and the 48-hour indication commitment explicitly.
generic.Evidence location: Submission correspondence folder in the portal plus the logged email on the broker contact record.

steps.title: Claim the unacknowledged submission from the Broker & Agent Portal intake queue
sop: Filter the portal intake queue to submissions with no acknowledgment activity recorded.
Open the earliest item and note the inbound message timestamp that starts the 4-hour clock.
Done when the submission is claimed and its received timestamp is written on the record.
verify: Confirm the claimed item shows your user id as the picker in the portal queue.
Pass when the submission is claimed and the received timestamp is visible on the record.

steps.title: Confirm reference, insured and effective date on the CRM submission record
sop: Open the submission in CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) and read the header block.
Check the submission reference, named insured legal name and requested effective date against the ACORD form.
Done when all three values match the broker paperwork exactly.
verify: Re-read the ACORD application header against the CRM values field by field.
Pass when reference, insured name and effective date agree with the submitted application.

steps.title: Identify the producing broker contact of record in CRM
sop: Open the producing broker account in CRM and locate the contact flagged as contact of record.
Check the email address is current and not marked bounced or inactive.
Done when a valid contact of record email is selected for the acknowledgment.
verify: Compare the chosen contact with the sender of the inbound submission.
Pass when the contact of record is active and matches the submitting broker office.

steps.title: Draft the acknowledgment note in the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Start a portal message on the submission and use the standard acknowledgment template.
Insert the submission reference, named insured and requested effective date into the body.
Done when the draft states all three identifiers in plain text.
verify: Read the draft body back against the submission header.
Pass when reference, insured and requested effective date all appear in the draft.

steps.title: State the turnaround commitment and SLA dates in the draft
sop: Add the commitment of an indication within 48 hours and a firm quote within 5 business days.
Express both as calendar dates derived from the received timestamp, not as relative wording alone.
Done when the draft carries explicit indication and firm quote target dates.
verify: Recalculate both dates from the received timestamp using the working-day calendar.
Pass when the stated dates match the recalculated SLA dates.

steps.title: Send the acknowledgment through the portal and email with the UW mailbox copied
sop: Address the message to the broker contact of record and copy the assigned underwriting mailbox.
Send through the Broker & Agent Portal and mirror it by Microsoft Teams / Email.
Done when the send confirmation and timestamp are returned.
verify: Check the elapsed time between the received timestamp and the send timestamp.
Pass when the acknowledgment is sent within 4 hours and the mailbox is on copy.

steps.title: File the sent copy and close the acknowledgment activity
sop: Save the sent copy to the submission correspondence folder with its send timestamp.
Close the acknowledgment activity on the submission record in CRM.
Done when the activity shows status complete with the filed copy attached.
verify: Open the correspondence folder and confirm the filed copy opens and carries the timestamp.
Pass when the activity is closed and the sent copy is retrievable from the submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every logged new-business submission that requires a system-generated unique reference number.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions logged in the current business day before they are routed to underwriting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reference number field populated by the policy admin sequence with the correct LOB and company prefix.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of distinct references equals count of logged submissions with no duplicates.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reference generation event held in the policy admin audit trail with user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any manual reference override logged with reason and the case manager approval recorded.
generic.Test population: All submission references created in the review period across all writing companies.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any reference is duplicated or if the prefix does not match the LOB and writing company.
generic.Exception handling path: Prefix or sequence faults raised to the New Business Case Manager and the policy admin support queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Search on the reference returns exactly one submission stamped on shell, folder and clearance record.
generic.Evidence location: Policy administration system submission header and the audit trail entry for the reference sequence.

steps.title: Open the logged submission in the policy administration system
sop: Locate the submission by insured name and received date in Guidewire PolicyCenter or the equivalent.
Confirm the record is in draft status and has no reference number yet.
Done when the correct unnumbered submission is open for editing.
verify: Check the header shows a blank reference and a draft status.
Pass when the open record is the intended submission and is still unnumbered.

steps.title: Confirm line of business and writing company drive the prefix
sop: Read the LOB and writing company recorded on the submission header.
Look up the expected reference prefix for that pairing in the numbering standard.
Done when the expected prefix for this risk is known before saving.
verify: Compare the LOB and company on the record with the ACORD application and producer agreement.
Pass when the expected prefix follows from the recorded LOB and writing company.

steps.title: Trigger the sequence by saving the submission without manual override
sop: Save the submission so the policy admin sequence allocates the next reference.
Do not type a reference by hand and do not reuse a number from a cancelled submission.
Done when a system-generated reference is displayed on the submission header.
verify: Check the audit trail shows the reference created by the sequence, not by user entry.
Pass when the reference is system generated and the override flag is unset.

steps.title: Validate the generated reference against the prefix convention
sop: Compare the allocated prefix with the expected LOB and writing company prefix.
Raise a support ticket if the prefix is wrong rather than editing the number.
Done when the prefix is confirmed correct or a ticket is open.
verify: Re-read the prefix character by character against the numbering standard.
Pass when the prefix matches the standard for this LOB and company.

steps.title: Stamp the reference on the policy shell, document folder and clearance record
sop: Copy the reference onto the policy shell header in the underwriting workstation.
Rename the document folder and update the clearance record with the same reference.
Done when all three artefacts carry the identical reference string.
verify: Open each artefact and compare the reference strings side by side.
Pass when shell, folder and clearance record all show the same reference.

steps.title: Run a uniqueness search on the new reference
sop: Search the policy administration system on the full reference string.
Review the result set for any second submission carrying the same reference.
Done when the search returns exactly one submission record.
verify: Repeat the search including closed and cancelled submissions.
Pass when exactly one record is returned across all statuses.

generic.Defined scope/population: All mandatory submission header fields for the logged new-business risk being registered.
generic.In-scope period: Metadata keyed at registration before the submission is released to appetite screening.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured legal name, LOB, coverage part, inception and expiry, address, state and NAICS or SIC all set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Field count captured matches the mandatory field list for the selected line of business.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Keyed values held on the submission header with the save timestamp and keying user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Fields that cannot be sourced raised as open requirements with the chase decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All submissions registered in the review period for the line of business under test.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any mandatory field is blank or if requested inception is dated in the past.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous class or coverage selections referred to the Underwriter before the record is saved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No mandatory-field validation error remains and no picklist value is set to Other.
generic.Evidence location: Submission header in the policy administration system and the underwriting workstation detail tab.

steps.title: Key the named insured legal name and DBA from the ACORD application
sop: Open the submission header in the policy administration system.
Type the legal name and any DBA exactly as printed on the ACORD application.
Done when both name fields match the application character for character.
verify: Read the application name back against the keyed values.
Pass when legal name and DBA match the ACORD form with no abbreviation.

steps.title: Select line of business, coverage part and program code from the picklists
sop: Choose the LOB and coverage part that match the coverage requested on the application.
Select the program code for the distribution channel and do not choose Other.
Done when all three picklist values are set from controlled lists.
verify: Check no selected value reads Other or Miscellaneous.
Pass when LOB, coverage part and program code are all controlled-list values.

steps.title: Enter requested inception and expiry dates on the submission
sop: Key the requested inception and expiry dates from the broker submission email or application.
Reject any inception dated before today and query it with the broker instead.
Done when a forward-dated inception and a matching expiry are saved.
verify: Compare the term length against the standard policy period for the product.
Pass when inception is not in the past and the term length is valid.

steps.title: Capture mailing address, domicile state and primary class code
sop: Enter the mailing address and state of domicile from the application.
Select the primary SIC or NAICS class code that matches the described operations.
Done when address, domicile state and class code are populated.
verify: Check the class code description against the operations narrative on the application.
Pass when the class code plausibly describes the insured operations.

steps.title: Populate producer code, sub-producer and commission basis
sop: Look up the producing broker code and any sub-producer in the producer register.
Set the commission basis from the producer agreement for this LOB.
Done when producer, sub-producer and commission basis are saved on the header.
verify: Check the producer code resolves to an active producer record.
Pass when the producer resolves and the commission basis matches the agreement.

steps.title: Clear all mandatory-field validation errors on save
sop: Save the submission and read the validation panel in the underwriting workstation.
Resolve each mandatory-field error, raising a requirement where data is genuinely unavailable.
Done when the record saves with no outstanding mandatory-field error.
verify: Re-run validation after the final save.
Pass when the validation panel returns zero mandatory-field errors.

steps.title: Have the underwriter confirm class and coverage selections
sop: Review the keyed LOB, coverage part and class code against the described risk.
Correct or return any selection that misstates the exposure.
Done when the underwriter records agreement on the submission activity trail.
verify: Check the activity trail for the underwriter confirmation entry.
Pass when a dated underwriter confirmation of the metadata exists.

generic.Defined scope/population: Named insured, all additional named insureds, DBAs, 25 percent beneficial owners and named officers.
generic.In-scope period: Screening run at registration and before the submission passes clearance.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each party carries full name, address and role, and the screening reference id is stored.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties submitted to the screening engine equal parties listed on the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening case output filed with list version date and run timestamp on the submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every fuzzy hit dispositioned true match or false positive with a written rationale.
generic.Test population: All screening cases raised against submissions registered in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any named party is unscreened or any hit remains undispositioned at clearance.
generic.Exception handling path: True matches escalated to the Sanctions Analyst and the submission blocked from progressing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clear or flagged outcome stamped on the submission header with screening reference and list date.
generic.Evidence location: Sanctions screening system case record plus the screening block on the policy admin submission.

steps.title: Build the party list for screening from the submission record
sop: List the named insured, every additional named insured and each DBA from the application.
Add beneficial owners at 25 percent or above and named directors and officers as separate parties.
Done when the party list covers every entity and individual on the submission.
verify: Compare the party list with the ownership section of the application.
Pass when every named entity and qualifying owner appears on the list.

steps.title: Submit the party list to the sanctions screening system
sop: Create a screening case in LexisNexis Bridger or FircoSoft for the submission reference.
Load each party with full name, address and country of domicile.
Done when every party on the list is loaded into the case.
verify: Count the parties loaded in the case against the prepared list.
Pass when the loaded party count equals the prepared party count.

steps.title: Run screening against SDN, non-SDN and comprehensive-jurisdiction lists
sop: Select the SDN list, the consolidated non-SDN lists and the comprehensive country list.
Run the case and record the list version date returned by the engine.
Done when the run completes with the list scope and version date captured.
verify: Check the case header shows all three list sets in scope.
Pass when the run covers SDN, non-SDN and country lists with a current version date.

steps.title: Disposition every fuzzy hit with a written rationale
sop: Open each hit and compare name, date of birth, address and jurisdiction with the list entry.
Mark the hit as true match or false positive and type the reasoning that supports it.
Done when no hit on the case remains in pending status.
verify: Re-open the case hit list and read each rationale.
Pass when every hit carries a disposition and a written rationale.

steps.title: Escalate any true match and block the submission
sop: Raise a true match to the sanctions escalation route defined for the writing company.
Set the submission screening status to flagged so it cannot progress past clearance.
Done when the escalation is raised and the block is in place.
verify: Attempt to advance the submission and confirm the block holds.
Pass when a flagged submission cannot be advanced past clearance.

steps.title: Stamp the screening outcome on the submission header
sop: Record the screening reference id, list version date and clear or flagged outcome on the header.
Attach the screening case output to the submission document folder.
Done when the header carries the reference, list date and outcome.
verify: Open the submission header and the filed screening output.
Pass when reference id, list version date and outcome are all present.

steps.title: Confirm no submission advanced with pending screening
sop: Filter the underwriting queue for submissions with screening status pending or flagged.
Return any such submission to the screening step before underwriting continues.
Done when no advanced submission carries a pending screening status.
verify: Re-run the queue filter after the corrections.
Pass when the filter returns no advanced submission with pending screening.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cleared submissions that need a policy shell created under the correct account in the policy admin system.
generic.In-scope period: Shell creation during registration, before the submission is routed to an underwriting team.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Product, writing company, term dates, rating state and producer code populated on the submission job.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One submission job exists per registered submission with no duplicate account created.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Job creation event with user and timestamp held in the PolicyCenter audit trail.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Account match failures logged with the search evidence and the create-new decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All submission jobs created in the review period for the writing company under test.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a duplicate account exists for the same insured and address or if the producer code is blank.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous account matches referred to the New Business Case Manager before the job is created.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Job sits at draft or submission status with target quote date blank until assignment.
generic.Evidence location: Guidewire PolicyCenter account and job records plus the account search history.

steps.title: Search PolicyCenter for an existing account for the insured
sop: Search on legal name, DBA, FEIN and address before creating anything.
Review near matches on address and FEIN rather than accepting an exact-name miss.
Done when an existing account is identified or the search is evidenced as returning none.
verify: Re-run the search on FEIN alone and on address alone.
Pass when the searches agree that the account exists or does not exist.

steps.title: Create the submission job against the matched account
sop: Open the matched account and start a new submission job from it.
Do not create a second account where an existing one was found.
Done when the job is attached to the correct existing account.
verify: Open the account and list its jobs.
Pass when the new job appears under the single correct account.

steps.title: Select product, writing company and policy term dates
sop: Choose the product and writing company that match the captured submission metadata.
Enter the requested inception and expiry as the policy term.
Done when product, company and term match the registered metadata.
verify: Compare the job header with the submission metadata screen.
Pass when product, writing company and term agree across both records.

steps.title: Set the primary rating state from the insured operations
sop: Determine the state holding the largest exposure from the location or operations schedule.
Set the rating state and jurisdiction from that exposure, not from the broker address.
Done when the rating state reflects where the insured operates.
verify: Compare the rating state with the location schedule and the broker address.
Pass when the rating state follows the exposure rather than the broker address.

steps.title: Attach the producer code to the job
sop: Select the producing broker code recorded at registration.
Confirm the code resolves so commission and licensing checks can run downstream.
Done when the producer code is attached and resolves to an active producer.
verify: Run the licensing check preview on the job.
Pass when the producer resolves and the licensing check returns a result.

steps.title: Leave the job at draft status with target quote date blank
sop: Confirm the job status reads draft or submission and has not been advanced.
Confirm the target quote date field is still blank pending assignment.
Done when the job is saved in draft with no target quote date set.
verify: Re-open the job header after saving.
Pass when status is draft or submission and target quote date is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound broker, agent and MGA submissions sitting in the portal queue or new-business mailbox.
generic.In-scope period: Items received in the current business day and not yet marked as picked up.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Producing broker, sub-producer, MGA, channel type and received date and time all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attachment count filed to the document folder equals attachment count on the inbound message.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Received date and time taken from the inbound message header and stored on the submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreadable or missing attachments logged and chased with the broker, with the outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: All intake items claimed in the review period across portal, mailbox and MGA feed channels.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any attachment is missing from the folder or if the SLA clock start time was keyed by hand.
generic.Exception handling path: Items that cannot be identified to a broker are held and referred to the New Business Case Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission is marked picked up, source block complete and no item left unclaimed in the queue.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText document folder for the submission plus the source block on the policy admin record.

steps.title: Pick up the inbound item from the portal queue or new-business mailbox
sop: Open the Broker & Agent Portal intake queue and the shared new-business mailbox.
Claim the oldest unclaimed item and mark it as picked up so it is not double handled.
Done when the item shows as claimed by you.
verify: Refresh the queue and mailbox view.
Pass when the item no longer shows as unclaimed to other users.

steps.title: Record the received date and time from the inbound message header
sop: Open the message header or portal receipt and read the original delivery timestamp.
Copy that timestamp to the submission received field to start the SLA clock.
Done when the received field matches the inbound header timestamp.
verify: Compare the stored received timestamp with the message header.
Pass when the two timestamps are identical, not the keying time.

steps.title: Capture producing broker, sub-producer and MGA on the source block
sop: Identify the producing broker and any sub-producer from the covering message and ACORD form.
Record the MGA or wholesaler where the business arrives through a delegated channel.
Done when the source block names every intermediary in the chain.
verify: Compare the source block against the covering email signature and the application.
Pass when producing broker, sub-producer and MGA agree with the paperwork.

steps.title: Set the channel type to portal, email or MGA feed
sop: Select the channel value that matches how the submission actually arrived.
Do not default to email for items pulled from the portal queue.
Done when the channel type reflects the true arrival route.
verify: Trace the item back to its arrival queue.
Pass when the recorded channel matches the queue the item came from.

steps.title: Save every attachment to the OpenText submission document folder
sop: Save ACORD forms, SOV, loss runs and supplemental questionnaires to the submission folder.
Keep the original filenames so the broker can be referred back to what they sent.
Done when every attachment on the inbound message is filed.
verify: Count files in the folder against attachments on the inbound message.
Pass when the counts match and original filenames are retained.

steps.title: Confirm the item has left the unclaimed intake queue
sop: Filter the intake queue for unclaimed items older than the current business day.
Confirm this submission does not appear and chase any that do.
Done when the submission is absent from the unclaimed queue.
verify: Re-run the unclaimed filter after registration.
Pass when the registered submission no longer appears as unclaimed.

generic.Defined scope/population: All received broker submissions awaiting entry into the underwriting system as records.
generic.In-scope period: Items received today and required to be logged before the close of the same business day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Account, received date, estimated premium, requested limits and submission type all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged submissions equals count of intake items claimed in the same window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Record creation event with keying user and save timestamp held in the policy admin audit trail.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items that cannot be logged same day recorded with the blocker and the resolution date.
generic.Test population: All new-business submission records created in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if received date differs from the inbound timestamp or type is not New Business.
generic.Exception handling path: Account search ambiguity referred to the New Business Case Manager before a new account is created.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Record saved, reference returned to the intake log and nothing left in received-not-logged state.
generic.Evidence location: Policy administration system submission register and the intake log in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Search the policy administration system for an existing account
sop: Search on legal name, DBA, FEIN and address for a matching account.
Create a new account only where the search evidences no match.
Done when the target account is chosen or a new one is justified.
verify: Re-run the search on FEIN alone to catch name variants.
Pass when the account decision is supported by both searches.

steps.title: Create the submission record under the chosen account
sop: Start a new submission under the account in the underwriting workstation.
Carry across the insured details already captured at intake.
Done when the submission record exists under the correct account.
verify: Open the account and list its open submissions.
Pass when the new submission appears under the intended account only.

steps.title: Set the received date to the actual inbound timestamp
sop: Copy the inbound message timestamp captured at intake into the received date field.
Do not accept the system default of the current keying date and time.
Done when the received date equals the inbound timestamp.
verify: Compare the received date with the intake record timestamp.
Pass when the two values are identical.

steps.title: Key estimated premium and requested limits so triage rules fire
sop: Enter the estimated premium and the requested limits from the broker submission.
Where the broker gave no estimate, enter the expiring premium and mark it as indicative.
Done when premium and limits are populated for sizing rules.
verify: Check the triage sizing rules have evaluated on save.
Pass when a sizing band is returned rather than left null.

steps.title: Set the submission type to New Business
sop: Select New Business as the submission type on the record header.
Correct any default of Renewal or Endorsement inherited from the account.
Done when the submission type reads New Business.
verify: Re-read the type field after save.
Pass when the type is New Business and not Renewal or Endorsement.

steps.title: Save the record and return the reference to the intake log
sop: Save the submission and copy the allocated reference into the intake log row.
Mark the intake row as logged so it clears the received-not-logged list.
Done when the intake log row carries the submission reference.
verify: Filter the intake log for received-not-logged items.
Pass when no item from the current business day remains unlogged.

generic.Defined scope/population: All logged new-business submissions requiring clearance against existing accounts and competing brokers.
generic.In-scope period: Clearance performed after logging and before the submission is assigned to an underwriter.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Search terms, matched accounts, broker of record and clearance disposition recorded on the submission.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of clearance records equals count of logged submissions for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Search evidence and clearance disposition stored with reviewer and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conflicts logged with the competing broker, the first-in-time outcome and the BOR position.
generic.Test population: All clearance records created in the review period across writing companies.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any submission was assigned to an underwriter while clearance status reads conflict.
generic.Exception handling path: Broker of record disputes referred to the Underwriter and held pending a BOR letter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clearance result reads cleared, conflict or pending BOR letter with the searches evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Clearance record on the policy admin submission plus the account search history.

steps.title: Search the account base on name, DBA, FEIN and address
sop: Run separate searches on legal name, DBA, FEIN and street address in the policy admin system.
Capture the result sets so the searches performed are evidenced on the clearance record.
Done when all four searches are run and their results captured.
verify: Open the clearance record and read the captured search evidence.
Pass when all four search types are evidenced with their results.

steps.title: Identify prior and competing submissions for the same insured
sop: Review matched accounts for open submissions and recent prior submissions.
Note the effective dates and coverage parts of any competing item.
Done when every competing submission is listed on the clearance record.
verify: Cross-check the competing list against open submissions for the account.
Pass when no open competing submission is missing from the list.

steps.title: Compare broker of record with the producing broker on this submission
sop: Read the broker of record held on the matched account.
Compare it with the producing broker recorded on this submission.
Done when the comparison result is recorded as same or different broker.
verify: Re-read both broker values side by side.
Pass when the recorded comparison matches the two source values.

steps.title: Apply the first-in-time rule where a different broker holds the account
sop: Compare received timestamps of the competing submissions.
Flag the later submission and record that the earlier broker holds the account.
Done when the first-in-time outcome is recorded on both submissions.
verify: Check both submissions carry the same first-in-time conclusion.
Pass when the earlier submission holds and the later one is flagged.

steps.title: Review blocked, no-quote and prior-declination flags on the account
sop: Open the account flags panel and read any blocked or no-quote marker.
Read prior declination reasons to see whether they still apply.
Done when all account flags have been read and noted.
verify: List the flags noted against the flags visible on the account.
Pass when every active flag is reflected in the clearance note.

steps.title: Stamp the clearance disposition on the submission
sop: Select cleared, conflict or pending BOR letter as the clearance result.
Attach the search evidence and the reasoning to the clearance record.
Done when the disposition and its evidence are saved.
verify: Open the submission header and read the clearance status.
Pass when a disposition is present with attached search evidence.

steps.title: Block assignment while clearance status reads conflict
sop: Filter the assignment queue for submissions with clearance status conflict.
Return any such submission to clearance rather than assigning it.
Done when no conflicted submission sits in the assignment queue.
verify: Re-run the conflict filter over the assignment queue.
Pass when the filter returns no assigned submission in conflict.

generic.Defined scope/population: Logged submissions checked against open submissions and in-force policies for the same insured.
generic.In-scope period: Duplicate check run at registration for the requested effective date window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Duplicate check outcome and any matched submission or policy number recorded on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of duplicate checks equals count of submissions logged in the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Search results and outcome stored on the submission with reviewer and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicates closed with reason duplicate and the retained reference recorded on both records.
generic.Test population: All submissions logged in the review period for the effective date window under test.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if two open submissions remain for the same insured, coverage part and effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Duplicates arriving from a different broker routed to clearance rather than closed silently.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Outcome recorded as duplicate or unique with the matched reference where applicable.
generic.Evidence location: Duplicate check note on the policy admin submission and the in-force policy search result.

steps.title: Run a fuzzy name search across open submissions
sop: Search open submissions on the insured name with fuzzy matching enabled.
Restrict the result to the requested effective date window.
Done when the fuzzy name result set is captured.
verify: Spot check two near-name results for genuine relevance.
Pass when the result set covers the effective date window in full.

steps.title: Run an exact FEIN search across open submissions
sop: Search open submissions on the exact FEIN from the application.
Note any match whose name differs from this submission.
Done when the FEIN search result is captured.
verify: Compare the FEIN result set with the fuzzy name result set.
Pass when matches found by either search are both carried forward.

steps.title: Check the in-force policy list for the same insured and coverage part
sop: Search in-force policies for the insured and the requested coverage part.
Flag any in-force cover that would make this a mid-term resubmission.
Done when the in-force position for this coverage is known.
verify: Open any matched policy and check its term and coverage part.
Pass when in-force overlap is either confirmed or ruled out.

steps.title: Close the later record where a same-broker duplicate is confirmed
sop: Retain the earlier reference and close the later submission as duplicate.
Record the retained reference on the closed record so the trail is traceable.
Done when only one open submission remains for the insured and coverage.
verify: Search open submissions again for the insured and coverage part.
Pass when exactly one open submission remains.

steps.title: Route different-broker duplicates to clearance rather than closing
sop: Compare the producing brokers on the two matching submissions.
Where they differ, route the later item to clearance for the first-in-time decision.
Done when the different-broker case sits with clearance, not closed.
verify: Check the routed item status and owning queue.
Pass when the different-broker duplicate is in clearance and still open.

steps.title: Record the duplicate check outcome on the submission
sop: Select the outcome of unique, duplicate closed or routed to clearance.
Enter the matched submission or policy number where one was found.
Done when outcome and matched reference are stored on the submission.
verify: Re-open the submission and read the duplicate check note.
Pass when an outcome is present with the matched reference where applicable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Registered submissions that must be routed to an underwriting team queue by LOB, region and premium band.
generic.In-scope period: Routing performed at the end of registration on the day the submission is logged.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: LOB, rating state, premium band and target queue populated before the route action runs.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of routed submissions equals count of registered submissions for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing decision and target queue written to the activity trail with user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions that match no routing rule logged and manually routed with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All routing events in the review period across specialty, delegated authority and open-market queues.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any submission sits in the unrouted catch-all queue after registration completes.
generic.Exception handling path: Unstaffed or out-of-office desks redirected to the backup queue by the UW Operations Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission is visible in the queue the routing matrix predicts for its LOB, state and premium.
generic.Evidence location: Routing activity on the policy admin submission and the target queue in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Read LOB, rating state and premium band from the submission
sop: Open the submission header in the policy administration system.
Note the line of business, rating state or region and the estimated premium band.
Done when the three routing inputs are known.
verify: Compare the three values against the registered metadata.
Pass when LOB, state and premium band all match the submission record.

steps.title: Derive the target team from the routing matrix
sop: Look up the routing matrix row for this LOB, region and premium band.
Record the queue the matrix returns before making any manual change.
Done when the matrix-derived target queue is identified.
verify: Re-run the matrix lookup independently.
Pass when the same target queue is returned on both lookups.

steps.title: Divert specialty classes to the specialty desk queue
sop: Check the risk for professional lines, excess casualty or surplus lines characteristics.
Where present, route to the specialty desk queue instead of the general desk.
Done when specialty risks are pointed at the specialty queue.
verify: Check the coverage parts requested against the specialty trigger list.
Pass when every specialty trigger has produced a specialty queue routing.

steps.title: Divert programs and delegated authority business to the DA queue
sop: Check whether the submission arrives under a binder or coverholder arrangement.
Route delegated business to the DA queue rather than the open-market desk.
Done when delegated business is queued to the DA desk.
verify: Compare the source channel with the routing chosen.
Pass when binder business sits in the DA queue and not open market.

steps.title: Confirm the target queue is staffed today
sop: Check the desk roster and absence calendar for the target queue.
Redirect to the backup queue where the desk is unstaffed.
Done when the final target queue has a live owner today.
verify: Re-check the roster for the final queue after any redirect.
Pass when the final queue has at least one available owner today.

steps.title: Execute the route and log the decision on the activity trail
sop: Run the route action to the confirmed target queue.
Write the routing decision and target queue to the submission activity trail.
Done when the submission is in the target queue with the decision logged.
verify: Filter the unrouted catch-all queue for this submission.
Pass when the submission is in the target queue and absent from the catch-all.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions still NIGO after the SLA window with at least two documented chases to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: Escalations raised once the NIGO SLA window has elapsed and before requested inception.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outstanding items, chase dates, days since receipt and recommended disposition all stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of escalations equals count of NIGO items past the escalation threshold.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation note stored on the submission with author, timestamp and the chase history attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Escalations withdrawn because information arrived logged with the date it was received.
generic.Test population: All NIGO submissions in the review period that passed the escalation threshold.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a NIGO submission exceeded the threshold with no open escalation record.
generic.Exception handling path: Senior Underwriter decides hold, decline for insufficient information or extend, and records it.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation names the senior underwriter, the outstanding items and the chase history.
generic.Evidence location: Escalation record on the policy admin submission and the diary chase history.

steps.title: Identify NIGO submissions past the escalation threshold
sop: Filter the underwriting workstation for NIGO items older than the SLA window.
Exclude items where the missing information has since been logged.
Done when the escalation candidate list is produced.
verify: Spot check two candidates for genuinely outstanding requirements.
Pass when every listed candidate still has an open requirement.

steps.title: Confirm at least two documented chases exist
sop: Open the diary and correspondence history for the submission.
Confirm two or more dated chases were sent to the broker.
Done when the chase count and dates are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the correspondence log for chase evidence.
Pass when two or more dated chases are on file.

steps.title: List each outstanding requirement with its request dates
sop: Extract the open requirement lines from the submission.
Note against each the date it was first requested and each chase date.
Done when every open item carries its request and chase dates.
verify: Compare the list with the open requirement lines on the record.
Pass when no open requirement is missing from the escalation list.

steps.title: State days since receipt and days to requested inception
sop: Calculate days elapsed since the received timestamp.
Calculate days remaining to the requested inception date.
Done when both figures appear in the escalation note.
verify: Recalculate both figures from the submission dates.
Pass when the stated figures match the recalculated values.

steps.title: Record a recommended disposition of hold, decline or extend
sop: Weigh the missing information against the time left to inception.
State a single recommended disposition with one line of reasoning.
Done when a clear recommendation is written in the escalation note.
verify: Read the recommendation against the outstanding items list.
Pass when the recommendation follows from the stated facts.

steps.title: Route the escalation to the senior underwriter and record the decision
sop: Review the escalation note and decide hold, decline or extend.
Record the decision on the submission with the date and your name.
Done when the decision is stored on the submission record.
verify: Re-open the submission decision panel.
Pass when a dated senior underwriter decision is present.

steps.title: Inform the broker of the escalation outcome
sop: Send the outcome to the broker stating what happens next and by when.
File the sent message to the submission correspondence folder.
Done when the broker has been told the outcome in writing.
verify: Open the correspondence folder and locate the outcome message.
Pass when a dated outcome message to the broker is on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions with one or more open requirements that need a written NIGO deficiency notice.
generic.In-scope period: Notices issued on the day the completeness review identifies the gaps.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each missing item named with its reason, affected coverage part and a response-by date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items listed on the notice equal the open requirement lines on the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice PDF filed to the document folder with its issue timestamp and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items removed from the notice after issue logged with the reason they were withdrawn.
generic.Test population: All NIGO notices issued in the review period across lines of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open requirement is missing from the notice or has no response-by date.
generic.Exception handling path: Broker disputes over a requirement referred to the New Business Case Manager for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status reads NIGO or Pending Information with the notice document attached.
generic.Evidence location: Broker portal notice record plus the notice PDF in the submission document folder.

steps.title: Extract the open requirement lines from the submission
sop: Open the requirements panel on the policy admin submission.
List every requirement still in open status with its description.
Done when the full open requirement list is compiled.
verify: Count the compiled list against the open requirements panel.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Name each missing item precisely in the notice draft
sop: Write each item by its specific name such as five-year loss runs or signed ACORD 125.
Avoid generic wording such as loss information or further details.
Done when every item is named specifically enough to action.
verify: Read each line and ask whether a broker could act on it without calling.
Pass when every line names a specific document or data set.

steps.title: State why each item is needed and which coverage it affects
sop: Add one short reason per item explaining the underwriting need.
Name the coverage part that cannot be progressed without it.
Done when every item carries a reason and an affected coverage part.
verify: Check each item line for both a reason and a coverage part.
Pass when no item lacks either element.

steps.title: Set the response-by date and align it to the diary
sop: Choose a response-by date inside the SLA window and before requested inception.
Set the follow-up diary to the same date on the submission.
Done when notice date and diary date agree.
verify: Compare the notice response-by date with the diary due date.
Pass when the two dates are identical.

steps.title: State that the requested inception cannot be held without the information
sop: Add the standard paragraph on inception dates to the notice body.
Name the requested inception date so the impact is concrete.
Done when the notice carries the inception warning with the date.
verify: Read the notice for the inception paragraph and the date.
Pass when the warning and the specific inception date are present.

steps.title: Issue the notice through the broker portal and CRM
sop: Send the notice through the Broker & Agent Portal to the contact of record.
Log the outbound message against the broker contact in CRM.
Done when the notice is sent and logged with a timestamp.
verify: Open the broker contact activity list in CRM.
Pass when the notice appears as a logged outbound activity.

steps.title: Set status to NIGO and file the notice PDF
sop: Change the submission status to NIGO or Pending Information.
File the notice PDF to the submission document folder.
Done when status and filed notice are both in place.
verify: Re-open the submission header and the document folder.
Pass when status reads NIGO and the notice PDF is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All documents returned by the broker in response to an issued NIGO deficiency notice.
generic.In-scope period: Items received between notice issue and the stated response-by date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each filed document carries document type, received date and source broker in the index.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents filed equal documents attached to the broker response message.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Corrected re-sends saved as a new version with the superseded copy marked obsolete.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Partial responses logged with the residual outstanding items re-confirmed to the broker.
generic.Test population: All NIGO responses logged in the review period across brokers.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any requirement stays open although a filed document already satisfies it.
generic.Exception handling path: Unrequested extra documents filed and flagged to the underwriter rather than discarded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each returned document is matched to the NIGO line item it satisfies and that item ticked off.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText submission document folder and the requirements panel in the policy admin system.

steps.title: Collect the broker response from the portal or mailbox
sop: Open the broker response in the Broker & Agent Portal or the new-business mailbox.
Note the response date and the number of attachments supplied.
Done when the response and its attachment count are recorded.
verify: Compare the attachment count with the message contents.
Pass when every attachment on the message is accounted for.

steps.title: Match each document to the NIGO line item it satisfies
sop: Open the outstanding requirement list alongside the returned documents.
Map each document to the specific requirement it answers.
Done when every returned document is mapped or marked as unrequested.
verify: Read the mapping against the requirement descriptions.
Pass when each mapping genuinely satisfies the requirement wording.

steps.title: File and index each document in OpenText by type and date
sop: Save each document into its designated sub-folder in the submission file.
Set document type, received date and source broker on the index entry.
Done when every document carries a complete index entry.
verify: Search the folder by document type for each filed item.
Pass when each document is retrievable by its indexed type.

steps.title: Version corrected re-sends and mark superseded copies obsolete
sop: Save a corrected document as a new version of the existing item.
Mark the previous copy obsolete so the underwriter reads the current one.
Done when only one current version of each document is active.
verify: Open the version history for any re-sent document.
Pass when the latest version is active and older ones read obsolete.

steps.title: Tick off the satisfied requirement lines
sop: Close each requirement line that the filed documents now satisfy.
Leave any partially satisfied requirement open with a note on what is missing.
Done when the requirement panel reflects the documents on file.
verify: Compare open requirements with the filed document list.
Pass when no requirement stays open that a filed document satisfies.

steps.title: Flag unrequested extras and re-confirm residual items
sop: File any extra documents and flag them to the underwriter for review.
Re-confirm the residual outstanding items with the broker where the response was partial.
Done when extras are flagged and residual items re-confirmed.
verify: Read the correspondence log for the residual items message.
Pass when a dated re-confirmation exists for every partial response.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions requiring third-party loss history, credit and public-record data to complete underwriting.
generic.In-scope period: Orders placed after registration and before the risk is priced or quoted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Permissible purpose, matched business identity and vendor reference id captured on the order.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reports filed to the submission equal orders placed against that submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report PDF and vendor reference filed to the document folder with the retrieval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: No-hit or mismatched identity results logged with the decision to re-order or proceed.
generic.Test population: All third-party data orders raised in the review period across vendors.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if permissible purpose is absent or the report belongs to a same-name different entity.
generic.Exception handling path: Material public-record hits referred to the Underwriter before the submission progresses.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Order shows insurance underwriting purpose and a report returned on the matched identity.
generic.Evidence location: LexisNexis Risk order history and the report PDF in the submission document folder.

steps.title: Set permissible purpose to insurance underwriting on the order screen
sop: Open the order screen in LexisNexis Risk or the credit bureau service.
Select insurance underwriting as the permissible purpose before entering any search terms.
Done when permissible purpose is recorded on the order.
verify: Re-read the order header before submitting.
Pass when permissible purpose reads insurance underwriting.

steps.title: Resolve the business identity on FEIN or DUNS
sop: Enter the FEIN or DUNS number from the application rather than the name alone.
Review the returned identity address and officers against the submission.
Done when the matched identity is confirmed as this insured.
verify: Compare the matched entity address with the application address.
Pass when the matched identity is the submitting insured, not a same-name entity.

steps.title: Order prior-carrier loss history for the full experience period
sop: Check the years of loss runs already supplied by the broker.
Order prior-carrier loss history to cover the shortfall against the required period.
Done when the ordered coverage plus broker loss runs span the full period.
verify: Add the broker years to the ordered years and compare with the requirement.
Pass when the combined span meets the required experience period.

steps.title: Review public-record hits for liens, judgments and fraud indicators
sop: Open the public-record section of the returned report.
Note liens, judgments and prior fraud indicators that are material to the risk.
Done when material hits are summarised for the underwriter.
verify: Compare the summary against the report public-record section.
Pass when every material hit appears in the summary.

steps.title: File the report and vendor reference to the submission folder
sop: Save the report PDF to the third-party data sub-folder in the underwriting file.
Record the vendor reference id on the submission so the order is traceable.
Done when the report and its vendor reference are both filed.
verify: Open the filed report and check the reference matches the vendor order.
Pass when report and vendor reference id are both retrievable.

steps.title: Escalate material findings to the underwriter
sop: Read the summarised material findings against the risk being considered.
Decide whether the findings change appetite, pricing or the information required.
Done when the underwriter decision is recorded on the submission.
verify: Re-open the submission activity trail.
Pass when a dated underwriter response to the findings exists.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions whose NIGO items have been answered and now need completeness re-validation.
generic.In-scope period: Re-validation performed on the day supplementary documents are logged.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every previously open item carries a pass or still-outstanding result with date and reviewer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items re-checked equal items that were open on the original NIGO notice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Re-validation entry stored with date, reviewer and per-item outcome on the submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: New gaps created by late documents raised as fresh requirements with a response-by date.
generic.Test population: All re-validation entries recorded in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if status left NIGO while any mandatory item is still failing, or moved out while failing.
generic.Exception handling path: Stale documents outside currency limits rejected and re-requested from the broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated re-validation shows each checklist item marked pass or still outstanding.
generic.Evidence location: Re-validation note on the policy admin submission and the underwriting workstation checklist.

steps.title: Re-open the NIGO item list on the submission
sop: Open the requirements panel and list every item that was open at notice issue.
Note which are now closed by filed documents.
Done when the re-check list is prepared.
verify: Compare the list with the issued NIGO notice.
Pass when every notice item appears on the re-check list.

steps.title: Check each item against the document now on file
sop: Open the filed document for each item and read it against the requirement wording.
Mark the item pass or still outstanding with a short note.
Done when every item carries a pass or outstanding result.
verify: Spot check two passed items by re-reading the document.
Pass when the passed items genuinely satisfy their requirement.

steps.title: Check currency of the newly supplied documents
sop: Confirm loss runs are valued within 90 days and the SOV covers the current term.
Reject and re-request anything outside the currency limits.
Done when every new document is confirmed current or re-requested.
verify: Read the valuation dates on the loss runs and SOV.
Pass when all in-scope documents are inside their currency window.

steps.title: Re-key exposure data from late-arriving documents
sop: Update values, payroll and revenue on the exposure screens from the new documents.
Re-save so downstream rating validation runs on the corrected figures.
Done when the exposure screens reflect the latest documents.
verify: Compare a sample of keyed figures with the source document.
Pass when the sampled figures match the filed document.

steps.title: Raise fresh requirements for any new gap
sop: Identify gaps created by the supplementary information, such as a newly disclosed location.
Raise each as a new requirement line with a response-by date.
Done when every new gap has an open requirement.
verify: Read the new documents for disclosures with no matching requirement.
Pass when no new gap is left without an open requirement.

steps.title: Record the dated re-validation result
sop: Write the re-validation entry with date, reviewer and per-item outcome.
Leave the status at NIGO where any mandatory item still fails.
Done when the entry is saved and the status reflects the result.
verify: Re-read the entry against the item outcomes and the current status.
Pass when status and per-item outcomes are consistent.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions whose completeness checklist is fully satisfied and are ready for underwriting.
generic.In-scope period: Release performed on the day the submission reaches in-good-order status.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: In-good-order date, release timestamp and recalculated target quote date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of releases equals count of submissions reaching zero outstanding mandatory items.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Release event stored with releasing user and timestamp on the submission activity trail.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Releases reversed because a gap reappeared logged with the reason and the new NIGO items.
generic.Test population: All submissions released to the underwriting queue in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any release occurred with clearance or sanctions status unresolved.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved clearance or screening blocks the release and returns the item to the case manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission appears in the underwriting queue with an in-good-order date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Submission status history in the policy admin system and the underwriting queue view.

steps.title: Confirm zero outstanding mandatory checklist items
sop: Open the completeness checklist on the submission.
Confirm every mandatory line reads present or not applicable.
Done when no mandatory item is outstanding.
verify: Filter the checklist for outstanding mandatory lines.
Pass when the filter returns nothing.

steps.title: Confirm clearance and sanctions both show cleared
sop: Read the clearance disposition and the sanctions screening status on the header.
Return the submission to the relevant step if either is unresolved.
Done when both statuses read cleared.
verify: Re-read both status fields on the submission header.
Pass when clearance and sanctions are both cleared.

steps.title: Advance the status from NIGO or Intake to In Underwriting
sop: Run the release action in the policy administration system.
Confirm the release timestamp is captured on the status history.
Done when the status reads In Underwriting with a timestamp.
verify: Open the status history entry for the release.
Pass when the new status and its timestamp are recorded.

steps.title: Re-base the SLA clock to the in-good-order date
sop: Set the in-good-order date to the release date on the submission.
Let the SLA clock restart from that date rather than the original receipt.
Done when the in-good-order date is stored.
verify: Compare the in-good-order date with the release timestamp.
Pass when the two agree to the same business day.

steps.title: Recalculate the target quote date
sop: Apply the firm quote SLA to the in-good-order date.
Write the resulting target quote date to the submission header.
Done when a recalculated target quote date is saved.
verify: Recompute the target date from the in-good-order date.
Pass when the stored date matches the recomputed date.

steps.title: Notify the broker that the submission is with underwriting
sop: Send a short note confirming the file is complete and now with underwriting.
State the target quote date so the broker expectation is set.
Done when the note is sent and filed.
verify: Open the correspondence folder for the release note.
Pass when the note is on file and states the target quote date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every checklist line in the minimum information requirements set for the submission line of business.
generic.In-scope period: Completeness review run on registration day before the submission reaches underwriting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each checklist line carries a present, missing or not-applicable disposition.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Missing dispositions equal the number of open requirement lines raised.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review outcome stored with reviewer and date against the submission checklist.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Not-applicable dispositions logged with the reason the item does not apply to this risk.
generic.Test population: All completeness reviews recorded in the review period for the LOB under test.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any checklist line is blank or a missing item has no matching requirement raised.
generic.Exception handling path: Doubt over whether an item is required referred to the Underwriter for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every LOB checklist line dispositioned and every missing item has an open requirement.
generic.Evidence location: Completeness checklist on the submission and the requirements panel in the policy admin system.

steps.title: Open the LOB completeness checklist on the submission
sop: Load the minimum information requirements checklist for this line of business.
Confirm the checklist version matches the current product edition.
Done when the correct checklist is open against the submission.
verify: Compare the checklist version with the current published version.
Pass when the current checklist version is in use.

steps.title: Confirm the signed and current-dated ACORD application is present
sop: Open the filed application in the document folder.
Check it is signed, dated and covers the requested line of business.
Done when the application line is dispositioned.
verify: Re-read the signature block and date on the application.
Pass when the application is signed and dated within the acceptable window.

steps.title: Check loss runs for years, valuation date and carrier issue
sop: Count the years of loss runs supplied against the requirement for the LOB.
Confirm each is carrier issued and valued within 90 days.
Done when the loss run line is dispositioned.
verify: Read the valuation date and issuing carrier on each loss run.
Pass when years, valuation and issuer all meet the requirement.

steps.title: Check the exposure schedules required by the LOB
sop: Look for the statement of values, vehicle schedule or payroll and revenue schedule as required.
Confirm the schedule covers every location or unit named on the application.
Done when the schedule line is dispositioned.
verify: Count schedule rows against locations or units on the application.
Pass when the schedule covers every location or unit disclosed.

steps.title: Confirm class-specific supplemental questionnaires are present
sop: Identify the supplements required for the class such as contractors, habitational or cyber.
Check each required supplement is filed and signed.
Done when every required supplement line is dispositioned.
verify: Compare the class code with the supplement requirement table.
Pass when every supplement the class demands is on file.

steps.title: Raise a discrete requirement for each missing item
sop: Create a requirement line for every item dispositioned missing.
State the reason the item is needed on each requirement.
Done when missing items and requirement lines match one for one.
verify: Count missing dispositions against open requirement lines.
Pass when the two counts are equal.

steps.title: Have the underwriter confirm the disposition set
sop: Review the dispositions, particularly any marked not applicable.
Overturn any disposition that understates what underwriting needs.
Done when the underwriter records agreement on the checklist.
verify: Read the checklist for the underwriter confirmation entry.
Pass when a dated underwriter confirmation is present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions with open requirements that need a diary follow-up to chase the broker.
generic.In-scope period: Diaries set on the day the requirement is raised and dated inside the SLA window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Diary due date, named outstanding items and the owning queue all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of NIGO submissions equals count with at least one open or completed diary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary creation and closure events stored with user and timestamp on the submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Diaries closed without a broker response logged with the escalation raised instead.
generic.Test population: All diaries created in the review period against NIGO submissions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a NIGO submission has no follow-up diary or a diary falls after requested inception.
generic.Exception handling path: Third chase carries an escalation flag routing the item to the case manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Open diary exists with a due date inside the SLA window naming the outstanding items.
generic.Evidence location: Diary activity list in the underwriting workstation and the policy admin submission.

steps.title: Read the outstanding requirements and the SLA window
sop: List the open requirement lines on the submission.
Note the SLA response window and the requested inception date.
Done when the items and the date boundaries are known.
verify: Compare the noted dates with the submission header.
Pass when the SLA window and inception date are correctly read.

steps.title: Set the first diary date inside the SLA window
sop: Choose a first chase date inside the SLA window and before requested inception.
Create the diary activity on the submission for that date.
Done when the first diary is created with a compliant date.
verify: Compare the diary date with the SLA window and inception date.
Pass when the diary falls inside the window and before inception.

steps.title: Name the specific outstanding items in the diary text
sop: Write each outstanding item into the diary description.
Avoid generic text so the chaser does not have to re-read the file.
Done when the diary text lists every outstanding item.
verify: Compare the diary text with the open requirement list.
Pass when every open item appears in the diary text.

steps.title: Pre-set second and third chase dates with an escalation flag
sop: Create the second and third chase diaries at the standard intervals.
Set the escalation flag on the third so it routes for escalation.
Done when three chase diaries exist with the final one flagged.
verify: List the diaries on the submission and read their flags.
Pass when three chases exist and the last carries the escalation flag.

steps.title: Assign the diaries to the submission owner queue
sop: Set the diary owner to the submission owning queue, not a named individual.
Confirm the queue is monitored daily.
Done when all chase diaries sit on the owning queue.
verify: Open each diary and read the assigned owner.
Pass when no diary is assigned to an individual user.

steps.title: Close the diary when the information is logged
sop: Check diaries against submissions where supplementary information has been logged.
Close diaries that the logged information satisfies and cancel the later chases.
Done when no diary chases information already received.
verify: Cross-check open diaries against logged supplementary documents.
Pass when no open diary chases an item already on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every location and exposure row on the submission that feeds the rating engine.
generic.In-scope period: Validation run after exposure data entry and before the risk is rated or quoted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class code, rating basis, exposure units, values, limits and deductibles populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposure rows in PolicyCenter equal locations listed on the statement of values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation run output retained with the run timestamp against the submission.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Validation warnings accepted rather than fixed logged with the underwriter rationale.
generic.Test population: All exposure rows on submissions validated in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any row lacks class code, rating basis or exposure units, or a hard error remains.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolvable rating errors referred to the Underwriter before the submission progresses.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rating engine validate mode returns no hard error for the submission.
generic.Evidence location: Guidewire PolicyCenter exposure screens and the Earnix validation run output.

steps.title: Reconcile exposure rows against the statement of values
sop: Count locations on the SOV and compare with exposure rows in PolicyCenter.
Add or remove rows so the two agree exactly.
Done when row count equals SOV location count.
verify: Re-count both sets after the correction.
Pass when exposure rows and SOV locations reconcile.

steps.title: Populate class code, rating basis and exposure units per row
sop: Enter class code and rating basis for each location or unit.
Key the exposure units of payroll, sales, square footage or vehicle count as the basis requires.
Done when every row has all three values.
verify: Filter exposure rows for blank class code or exposure units.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Complete building values and COPE attributes per location
sop: Enter building, contents and business interruption values from the SOV.
Complete construction, occupancy, protection and exposure attributes for each location.
Done when COPE and values are complete for every location.
verify: Spot check two locations against the SOV rows.
Pass when sampled values and COPE attributes match the SOV.

steps.title: Enter limits, sub-limits, deductibles and retentions
sop: Key the requested limits, sub-limits, deductibles and retentions.
Check sub-limits do not exceed the policy limit and retentions are internally consistent.
Done when the structure is entered and internally consistent.
verify: Compare the entered structure with the broker requested structure.
Pass when the entered structure matches the request and is self consistent.

steps.title: Derive territory, protection class and rating state from the address
sop: Run the address standardisation so territory and protection class are derived, not typed.
Correct any address that fails to resolve rather than keying the values by hand.
Done when territory and protection class are system derived for every location.
verify: Check the derivation source flag on a sample of rows.
Pass when sampled rows show system derivation rather than manual entry.

steps.title: Run the rating engine in validate mode and clear hard errors
sop: Run Earnix Rating & Pricing in validate mode against the submission.
Resolve every hard error returned and re-run until none remain.
Done when the validate run returns no hard errors.
verify: Re-run validate mode after the last correction.
Pass when the run returns zero hard errors.

steps.title: Have the underwriter accept any residual warnings
sop: Review the remaining soft warnings from the validate run.
Record acceptance with a rationale or send the row back for correction.
Done when every residual warning is accepted or resolved.
verify: Read the warning list against the recorded acceptances.
Pass when no warning is left without an acceptance or a fix.

generic.Defined scope/population: All application forms, state-mandatory forms and signature blocks required for the rating state.
generic.In-scope period: Verification run during completeness review before the submission is released to underwriting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Applicant signature, producer signature, licence number and form edition dates all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms on file equal forms required by the state form list for this LOB.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed forms filed in OpenText with edition date and signing date recorded on the index.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Superseded editions or unsigned forms logged and re-requested from the broker.
generic.Test population: All submissions verified in the review period for the rating state under test.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any required form is unsigned or on a superseded edition at release.
generic.Exception handling path: Wet-signature-only forms without originals referred to the New Business Case Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed application plus every state-mandatory form filed with current edition dates.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText submission document folder and the forms panel in the policy admin system.

steps.title: Check the ACORD edition date against the approved state edition
sop: Read the edition date printed on the filed ACORD application.
Compare it with the current approved edition for the rating state.
Done when the edition is confirmed current or flagged superseded.
verify: Re-read the edition date against the approved forms list.
Pass when the application is on the current approved edition.

steps.title: Verify the applicant signature and its date
sop: Locate the applicant signature block on the application.
Check it is signed by an authorised officer and dated within the acceptable window.
Done when the applicant signature is confirmed valid.
verify: Compare the signatory title with the officers listed on the application.
Pass when the signature is by an authorised officer and in date.

steps.title: Verify the producer signature and licence number
sop: Locate the producer signature and licence or agency number on the application.
Check the number is legible and matches the producer record.
Done when producer signature and licence number are confirmed.
verify: Compare the licence number with the producer register entry.
Pass when the numbers agree and the signature is present.

steps.title: Confirm state-mandatory forms and fraud warnings are attached
sop: Pull the mandatory form list for the rating state and this LOB.
Check each listed form is filed and signed where signature is required.
Done when every mandatory form is accounted for.
verify: Count filed mandatory forms against the state list.
Pass when the counts reconcile with no gaps.

steps.title: Confirm originals or e-signature certificates for wet-signature forms
sop: Identify forms the state accepts only with a wet signature.
Confirm an original is held or a compliant e-signature certificate is attached.
Done when each such form has an original or a certificate.
