verify: Open the e-signature certificate and check it names the signer and date.
Pass when every wet-signature form is properly evidenced.

steps.title: Raise requirements for unsigned or superseded forms
sop: Create a requirement line for each unsigned or superseded form.
Include the correct edition reference so the broker sends the right version.
Done when every deficient form has an open requirement.
verify: Compare deficient forms with the open requirement lines.
Pass when each deficiency has a matching requirement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every insured location on the submission that must be tested against CAT and wildfire filters.
generic.In-scope period: Filters applied during appetite screening before pricing or quoting the risk.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Geocode quality, distance to coast, flood zone, wildfire WUI and quake zone captured per location.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Locations geocoded equal locations on the statement of values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: CAT filter output attached to the submission with model version and run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Locations in restricted tiers logged with the referral or approved exception recorded.
generic.Test population: All locations filtered in the review period across CAT-exposed states.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any location is ungeocoded or sits in a restricted tier without a referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Restricted-tier locations referred to the Exposure Management Manager before progression.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All locations geocoded to street level with hazard zone tiers recorded on the submission.
generic.Evidence location: Moody's RMS run output filed to the submission and the CAT block in the workstation.

steps.title: Geocode every location to street-level accuracy
sop: Load the location schedule into Moody's RMS and run geocoding.
Correct addresses that resolve only to ZIP centroid and re-run them.
Done when every location resolves to street level.
verify: Filter the geocode results for match levels below street.
Pass when no location remains below street-level accuracy.

steps.title: Return hazard flags per location from the CAT data provider
sop: Run the hazard lookup for distance to coast, named storm, wildfire WUI, flood and quake.
Record the returned flag values against each location row.
Done when every location carries all five hazard flags.
verify: Filter location rows for missing hazard flags.
Pass when no location has a missing flag.

steps.title: Check restricted-tier locations against the moratorium and no-write list
sop: Identify locations falling in restricted CAT tiers.
Compare each against the current moratorium and no-write list for the writing company.
Done when each restricted location is classified against the lists.
verify: Re-read the current moratorium list version date.
Pass when the comparison used the current list version.

steps.title: Measure the contribution to accumulation zone aggregate
sop: Sum the insured values entering each accumulation zone from this submission.
Compare against remaining capacity for that zone.
Done when the aggregate impact per zone is quantified.
verify: Re-check the remaining capacity figure against the current exposure report.
Pass when the impact is measured against current remaining capacity.

steps.title: Raise a referral for restricted-zone locations
sop: Raise a referral naming the restricted locations and their tiers.
State the aggregate impact and the requested exception if one is sought.
Done when every restricted location is covered by a referral.
verify: Compare restricted locations with open referrals.
Pass when no restricted location lacks a referral or exception.

steps.title: Attach the CAT filter output to the submission
sop: Export the zone, tier and aggregate impact output from the model run.
File it to the submission with the model version and run date.
Done when the output is filed and readable from the submission.
verify: Open the filed output from the submission record.
Pass when the output opens and shows model version and run date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions tested against individual underwriter authority and treaty reinsurance capacity.
generic.In-scope period: Assessment made during appetite screening before quoting or binding.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Total insured value, policy limit, estimated premium, attachment point and treaty class populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Combined layer exposure equals the sum of primary and excess limits on the structure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authority evaluation stored with tested values, matrix version and evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Breaches of authority logged with the referral raised to the next authority level.
generic.Test population: All authority evaluations recorded in the review period across lines of business.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a submission exceeding individual authority progressed without an open referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Risks above treaty capacity flagged to the Reinsurance Analyst for facultative placement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Evaluation records limit, premium and attachment tested against the authority matrix.
generic.Evidence location: Authority evaluation on the submission plus the treaty capacity view in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.

steps.title: Read total insured value and requested policy limit
sop: Open the submission exposure summary in the underwriting workstation.
Note the total insured value and the requested policy limit.
Done when both figures are recorded for the assessment.
verify: Compare the figures with the statement of values and the request.
Pass when the recorded figures match the submission data.

steps.title: Compare limit against per-risk authority for the LOB
sop: Look up your per-risk authority for this line of business.
Compare the requested limit with that authority ceiling.
Done when the limit test result is recorded as within or above authority.
verify: Re-check the authority ceiling from the current matrix version.
Pass when the test used the current authority matrix.

steps.title: Compare estimated premium against the premium authority band
sop: Read the estimated premium recorded at registration.
Compare it with the individual and desk premium authority bands.
Done when the premium test result is recorded.
verify: Re-read the premium band boundaries in the matrix.
Pass when the premium test result matches the band boundaries.

steps.title: Test combined exposure across attachment point and excess layers
sop: List the attachment point and every excess layer requested.
Sum the combined exposure rather than testing the layer in isolation.
Done when combined exposure is calculated and tested.
verify: Re-add the layer limits from the requested structure.
Pass when the combined figure matches the sum of the layers.

steps.title: Confirm treaty class, retention and remaining capacity
sop: Open Sapiens ReinsurancePro and identify the treaty class for this risk.
Read the per-risk retention and the remaining treaty capacity.
Done when treaty class, retention and remaining capacity are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the capacity figure as at the current date.
Pass when the capacity used is current and not a stale snapshot.

steps.title: Flag facultative need where treaty capacity is exceeded
sop: Compare the risk exposure with remaining treaty capacity.
Raise a facultative placement flag to the reinsurance desk where capacity is short.
Done when the facultative flag is raised or ruled out.
verify: Check the reinsurance desk queue for the raised flag.
Pass when a facultative flag exists for every capacity shortfall.

steps.title: Raise a referral where individual authority is exceeded
sop: Review the authority test results on the submission.
Open a referral to the next authority level for any breach before progression.
Done when every breach carries an open referral.
verify: Filter submissions above authority for open referrals.
Pass when no over-authority submission is progressing without a referral.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions with a recorded appetite decision of decline that must be communicated to the broker.
generic.In-scope period: Communication issued within 24 hours of the appetite decision being recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission reference, named insured, requested effective date and reason all present in the message.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Declination messages sent equal appetite decisions recorded as decline in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent declination copy filed to the submission with the delivery timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable declinations logged with the resend method and the eventual delivery date.
generic.Test population: All declined submissions in the review period across brokers and lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a declination is sent more than 24 hours after the decision was recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Broker challenges routed to the reconsideration process rather than answered ad hoc.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status reads Declined and the declination is visible to the broker with a sent timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal message record and the CRM activity on the broker contact.

steps.title: Confirm the appetite decision is recorded as decline
sop: Open the appetite decision record on the submission.
Confirm the outcome reads out of appetite with a reason code and timestamp.
Done when the decline decision and its timestamp are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the decision record fields.
Pass when outcome, reason code and timestamp are all present.

steps.title: Draft the declination message with the submission identifiers
sop: Start the declination message in the Broker & Agent Portal.
Include the submission reference, named insured and requested effective date.
Done when all three identifiers appear in the draft.
verify: Compare the draft identifiers with the submission header.
Pass when reference, insured and effective date all match.

steps.title: State the reason at the approved level of specificity
sop: Give the reason as appetite or class without disclosing internal scoring detail.
Use the approved wording for the reason code recorded on the decision.
Done when the reason wording matches the approved template.
verify: Compare the reason wording with the approved template text.
Pass when no internal scoring detail appears in the message.

steps.title: State plainly that no coverage is or will be in force
sop: Add the standard no-coverage paragraph to the message.
Avoid any wording that could be read as a conditional offer.
Done when the no-coverage statement is present and unambiguous.
verify: Read the message for any conditional or hedged wording.
Pass when the no-coverage statement is unqualified.

steps.title: Send through the portal and mirror by email within 24 hours
sop: Send the declination through the Broker & Agent Portal to the contact of record.
Log the outbound communication against the broker contact in CRM.
Done when both the portal send and the CRM log carry a timestamp.
verify: Measure elapsed time from the decision timestamp to the send timestamp.
Pass when the declination was sent within 24 hours of the decision.

steps.title: Set status to Declined and file the sent copy
sop: Change the submission status to Declined in the policy administration system.
File the sent declination copy to the submission document folder.
Done when status reads Declined with the copy filed.
verify: Re-open the submission header and document folder.
Pass when status reads Declined and the sent copy is retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions whose class or described operations may fall on the prohibited or no-write list.
generic.In-scope period: Screening performed during appetite review before the submission enters the standard queue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class code, guideline reference, flag type and target queue recorded on the submission.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flagged submissions equal those matching the prohibited-class rule set for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Flag stored with the guideline reference, list version and the flagging user and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exception requests logged with the business case and the CUO or senior approval route.
generic.Test population: All appetite screenings completed in the review period for the writing company.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a prohibited-class submission remains in the standard queue without decline or exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Exception requests routed to the Senior Underwriter and the approval recorded before progression.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Flag cites the specific class, hazard grade or activity that triggered it.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite flag on the policy admin submission and the prohibited-class list version in use.

steps.title: Check the class code against the prohibited and no-write lists
sop: Open the current prohibited-class and no-write lists for the writing company.
Search them for the submission primary and secondary class codes.
Done when the class position against both lists is known.
verify: Note the list version date used for the check.
Pass when the check used the current published list version.

steps.title: Read the operations narrative for prohibited activities
sop: Read the described operations on the application and any supplements.
Look for activities the class code alone would not reveal.
Done when the narrative has been assessed against the prohibited activity list.
verify: Compare any flagged activity with the prohibited activity wording.
Pass when the narrative assessment is recorded on the submission.

steps.title: Set the flag with the specific guideline reference
sop: Raise the out-of-appetite or prohibited-class flag on the submission.
Cite the class, hazard grade or activity and the guideline section that triggered it.
Done when the flag carries a specific guideline reference.
verify: Open the flag and read the cited reference.
Pass when the reference points to a real guideline section.

steps.title: Record the business case where an exception is sought
sop: Write the business case for the exception including mitigation and portfolio fit.
Name the required approval route for this class and size.
Done when the business case and approval route are recorded.
verify: Read the business case against the exception policy.
Pass when the case addresses the reason the class is prohibited.

steps.title: Route the submission to the decline or exception queue
sop: Move the flagged submission out of the standard underwriting queue.
Route it to the decline queue or the exception approval queue as applicable.
Done when the submission sits in the correct non-standard queue.
verify: Filter the standard queue for flagged submissions.
Pass when no flagged submission remains in the standard queue.

steps.title: Record the senior underwriter decision on the exception
sop: Review the business case and the guideline reference cited.
Approve or refuse the exception and record the decision with your name and date.
Done when the exception decision is stored on the submission.
verify: Re-open the exception record on the submission.
Pass when a dated approval or refusal is present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions carrying coverage parts or structures that trigger specialty desk ownership.
generic.In-scope period: Flagging performed during appetite screening before the risk is priced.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger, target specialty desk, attachment point and requested structure recorded on the referral.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Specialty referrals raised equal submissions matching the specialty trigger list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral stored with trigger, target desk, raising user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals declined by the specialty desk logged with the reason and the return route.
generic.Test population: All specialty referrals raised in the review period across desks.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a triggering submission has no referral or the referral is unacknowledged.
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged referrals chased to the Senior Underwriter after the acknowledgement window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral names the target desk and the trigger, and the primary desk retains the account.
generic.Evidence location: Referral record on the policy admin submission and the specialty desk queue in the workstation.

steps.title: Compare requested coverage parts with the specialty trigger list
sop: List the coverage parts requested on the submission.
Check each against the excess casualty, professional lines, cyber and environmental triggers.
Done when every triggering coverage part is identified.
verify: Re-read the trigger list version in force.
Pass when the comparison used the current trigger list.

steps.title: Identify surplus lines eligibility where the risk cannot be written admitted
sop: Check whether the writing company can write this class admitted in the rating state.
Mark the submission as non-admitted where it cannot.
Done when the admitted or non-admitted position is recorded.
verify: Compare the position with the state licence and filing position.
Pass when the recorded position matches the licensing reality.

steps.title: Review attachment point and underlying limits
sop: Read the attachment point and the underlying limits from the requested structure.
Decide whether the excess desk must own the risk under the desk split rules.
Done when the ownership conclusion is recorded.
verify: Compare the attachment point with the excess desk threshold.
Pass when the ownership conclusion follows the desk split rules.

steps.title: Raise the referral to the named specialty queue
sop: Create the referral naming the target specialty desk.
Summarise the trigger and the requested structure in the referral text.
Done when the referral is raised to the correct desk.
verify: Open the specialty desk queue and locate the referral.
Pass when the referral is visible in the target desk queue.

steps.title: Keep account ownership with the primary desk
sop: Confirm the account record still shows the primary desk as owner.
Do not transfer the account when only the referral moves.
Done when the account owner is unchanged after the referral.
verify: Re-read the account ownership panel.
Pass when the primary desk still owns the account record.

steps.title: Obtain acknowledgement from the specialty desk
sop: Monitor the referral for acknowledgement within the agreed window.
Chase the specialty desk where acknowledgement has not arrived.
Done when the referral shows acknowledged by the specialty desk.
verify: Open the referral status field.
Pass when the referral status reads acknowledged with a date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every submission that has completed appetite screening and needs its decision recorded.
generic.In-scope period: Decision recorded on the day appetite screening concludes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome, reason code, rationale text, decider name and decision timestamp all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Appetite decisions recorded equal submissions completing appetite screening in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision record stored with timestamp and any approver name for exceptions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exception approvals logged with approver name, level and date on the same record.
generic.Test population: All appetite decisions stored in the review period across desks.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any decision has a blank reason code or rationale shorter than the required length.
generic.Exception handling path: Decisions outside the controlled outcome list referred to the Senior Underwriter to re-record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision holds outcome, reason code, rationale, decider and timestamp with matching status.
generic.Evidence location: Appetite decision record on the policy admin submission and the workstation decision panel.

steps.title: Select the outcome from the controlled list
sop: Open the appetite decision panel on the submission.
Choose in appetite, out of appetite or exception approved from the controlled list.
Done when a controlled-list outcome is selected.
verify: Re-read the stored outcome value.
Pass when the outcome is one of the three controlled values.

steps.title: Choose the reason code from the standard taxonomy
sop: Pick the reason code that best matches the driver of the decision.
Do not select Other where a specific code exists.
Done when a specific taxonomy reason code is stored.
verify: Compare the code with the rationale text about to be written.
Pass when the code and the intended rationale agree.

steps.title: Write the rationale citing guideline, class and exposure feature
sop: State the guideline section relied on and the class code assessed.
Name the exposure feature that drove the call in plain terms.
Done when the rationale cites guideline, class and exposure feature.
verify: Read the rationale for all three elements.
Pass when guideline, class and exposure feature all appear.

steps.title: Capture approver details where an exception was approved
sop: Record the approver name, authority level and approval date on the decision record.
Confirm the approver holds the level the exception policy requires.
Done when approver name, level and date are stored.
verify: Compare the approver level with the exception policy requirement.
Pass when the approver holds the required authority level.

steps.title: Stamp the decision date and time
sop: Save the decision so the system stamps date, time and decider.
Do not backdate or overwrite an earlier decision record.
Done when the decision carries a system timestamp and decider name.
verify: Open the audit trail for the decision record.
Pass when the timestamp and decider are system generated.

steps.title: Move the submission status to match the decision
sop: Advance accepted submissions and set declined submissions to Declined.
Leave exception cases in the exception queue until approval is recorded.
Done when the status matches the recorded outcome.
verify: Compare submission status with the decision outcome.
Pass when status and outcome are consistent.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions with an accepted appetite decision awaiting routing to the assignment queue.
generic.In-scope period: Routing performed on the day the appetite decision is recorded as accepted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target queue, priority band, target quote date and linked referrals populated on the queue item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items entering the assignment queue equal accepted appetite decisions for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Route action logged with user and timestamp on the submission activity trail.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions that match no assignment queue logged and routed manually with the reason.
generic.Test population: All route-to-assignment actions in the review period across LOBs and regions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a routed submission still appears in the appetite screening queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Queue conflicts resolved by the UW Operations Manager before the route is executed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted submission appears in the assignment queue carrying priority band and target quote date.
generic.Evidence location: Assignment queue in the underwriting workstation and the routing activity on the submission.

steps.title: Confirm the appetite decision reads accepted
sop: Open the appetite decision record on the submission.
Confirm the outcome is in appetite or exception approved.
Done when acceptance is confirmed before any routing.
verify: Re-read the decision outcome field.
Pass when the outcome is accepted or exception approved.

steps.title: Select the assignment queue by LOB, region and premium band
sop: Look up the routing matrix row for the submission attributes.
Select the assignment queue the matrix returns.
Done when the matrix-derived assignment queue is selected.
verify: Repeat the matrix lookup independently.
Pass when the same queue is returned both times.

steps.title: Carry the priority band and target quote date onto the queue item
sop: Copy the priority band and target quote date onto the queue item fields.
Do not leave the assigner to re-derive them from scratch.
Done when both fields are populated on the queue item.
verify: Compare queue item fields with the submission header.
Pass when priority band and target quote date match the submission.

steps.title: Link any open specialty or reinsurance referral
sop: List open referrals on the submission.
Link each to the queue item so it travels with the submission.
Done when every open referral is linked.
verify: Open the queue item and list its linked referrals.
Pass when all open referrals appear on the queue item.

steps.title: Execute the route and clear the previous queue
sop: Run the route action to the assignment queue.
Confirm the submission has left the appetite screening queue.
Done when the submission is in the assignment queue only.
verify: Search both queues for the submission reference.
Pass when it appears in assignment and not in appetite screening.

steps.title: Confirm the route is logged with user and timestamp
sop: Open the submission activity trail.
Confirm the route action shows the acting user and a timestamp.
Done when the logged route entry is present and complete.
verify: Re-read the activity entry fields.
Pass when user and timestamp are both recorded on the route action.

generic.Defined scope/population: All insured parties, additional insureds and loss payees on the submission at appetite stage.
generic.In-scope period: Screening run at appetite stage and re-run whenever party details change.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party name, address, role, screening reference and list version date all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Screening cases raised equal parties listed on the submission including loss payees.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening outcome stored with list version date and run timestamp on the appetite record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Hits routed to the sanctions analyst queue and dispositioned before the block is lifted.
generic.Test population: All watchlist screening cases raised in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any submission advanced to assignment with an open undispositioned hit.
generic.Exception handling path: Open hits block progression and are escalated to the Sanctions Analyst for disposition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A completed screening case exists per insured party with the list version date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Sanctions screening system case record and the screening block on the appetite record.

steps.title: List every insured party, additional insured and loss payee
sop: Read the insured schedule, additional insured endorsements and loss payee list.
Build a party list covering all of them, not just the first named insured.
Done when the party list covers every interested party.
verify: Compare the list with the additional insured and loss payee schedules.
Pass when no scheduled party is missing from the list.

steps.title: Check whether party details changed since intake screening
sop: Compare current party names, addresses and ownership with the intake screening run.
Mark any changed party for a fresh screening run.
Done when changed parties are identified for re-screening.
verify: Re-read the intake screening party list against the current one.
Pass when every changed party is marked for re-screening.

steps.title: Set the watchlist scope to include PEP and adverse media
sop: Select sanctions plus PEP and adverse-media lists where the product requires them.
Do not run sanctions alone where the product demands wider scope.
Done when the required list scope is selected on the case.
verify: Read the case scope against the product screening standard.
Pass when the selected scope meets the product requirement.

steps.title: Run the screening and record the list version date
sop: Execute the case in the sanctions screening system.
Record the list version date returned with the results.
Done when the run completes and the list version date is stored.
verify: Compare the recorded list version with the vendor current version.
Pass when the run used the current list version.

steps.title: Route hits to the sanctions analyst queue and block progression
sop: Take any hit into the analyst queue for disposition.
Hold the submission block so it cannot advance to assignment.
Done when hits are queued and the block is confirmed active.
verify: Attempt to advance the submission while a hit is open.
Pass when advancement is blocked while a hit is open.

steps.title: Record screening reference and outcome on the appetite record
sop: Write the screening reference, list version date and outcome to the appetite record.
Attach the case output to the submission document folder.
Done when reference, list date and outcome are stored.
verify: Open the appetite record and the filed case output.
Pass when all three values are present and the output opens.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions whose primary and secondary operations must be screened against appetite guidelines.
generic.In-scope period: Screening performed at appetite stage before the risk moves toward quoting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Mapped NAICS or SIC, internal class, hazard grade, region and size band all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Screening outcomes recorded equal submissions entering appetite screening in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening outcome stored with the guideline section cited and the screening date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referral outcomes logged with the referral raised and the eventual decision.
generic.Test population: All appetite screening results recorded in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a submission reached quoting with a decline outcome and no approved exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Referral outcomes routed to the Senior Underwriter for a target or decline ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Result shows the mapped class code and the guideline outcome of target, acceptable, referral or decline.

steps.title: Translate the codes to internal class and hazard grade

steps.title: Check the class against target, referral and no-write lists

steps.title: Check geography and state moratoria against regional appetite

Check each against regional appetite and any active state moratorium.

verify: Compare the state list with the location schedule.

steps.title: Test the revenue or size band against the target market

Compare with the target-market size definition for the class.
Done when the size band assessment is recorded.
verify: Re-read the target-market definition boundaries.
Pass when the size assessment matches the definition boundaries.

steps.title: Record the screening outcome with the guideline section cited
sop: Select target, acceptable, referral or decline as the outcome.
Cite the guideline section that supports the outcome.

Pass when the outcome carries a specific guideline section reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every state of exposure on the submission and the coverage forms requested for each.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Eligibility recorded per state of exposure citing the approved product edition.

steps.title: List every state of exposure on the submission

Build the state list including states with only incidental operations.
Done when the full state list is recorded.
verify: Compare the list with the location schedule.
Pass when every state appearing on the schedule is listed.

steps.title: Confirm the writing company is licensed in each state

Note any state where the company is not licensed for this line.
Done when licence status is recorded for every state.
verify: Re-read the licence register entry for two sampled states.
Pass when the sampled statuses match the register.

steps.title: Confirm requested forms and endorsements are filed and approved
sop: List the coverage forms and endorsements requested.
Check each is filed and approved for use in the rating state.
Done when every form is confirmed filed or flagged unfiled.
verify: Compare the selected form editions with the filing register.
Pass when no selected edition is unfiled or withdrawn.

steps.title: Test requested limits against product and treaty maxima
sop: Read the maximum limit permitted by the product for this class.
Compare with the requested limit and the treaty capacity available.
Done when the limit test result is recorded.
verify: Re-read the product maximum and the treaty capacity figure.
Pass when the recorded test used both current values.

steps.title: Confirm the surplus lines route where the risk is non-admitted
sop: Where non-admitted, confirm diligent-search or export eligibility for the state.
Identify the surplus lines tax and stamping office route that will apply.
Done when the non-admitted route is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Compare the route with the state surplus lines requirement.
Pass when the recorded route satisfies the state requirement.

steps.title: Record the eligibility conclusion per state with the filing reference
sop: Write an eligible or ineligible conclusion for each state of exposure.
Cite the product edition and filing reference relied on.
Done when every state carries a conclusion and a citation.
verify: Count conclusions against the state list.
Pass when every state has a conclusion with a filing reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Accepted submissions in the assignment queue awaiting a priority band and target quote date.

generic.Evidence location: Priority fields on the policy admin submission and the assignment queue view.

steps.title: Calculate days to requested inception for each queued submission
sop: Read the requested inception date from the submission header.
Calculate working days remaining from today to that date.
Done when days to inception is stored on the submission.
verify: Recalculate the figure for two sampled submissions.
Pass when the stored figures match the recalculated values.

steps.title: Apply the premium band and account strategic tier
sop: Read the estimated premium band from the submission.
Add the strategic tier for target broker or target class where it applies.
Done when premium band and strategic tier are recorded.
verify: Compare the tier with the target broker and class lists.
Pass when the tier is supported by the published lists.

steps.title: Score complexity on layers, locations, coverage parts and referrals
sop: Count layers, locations and coverage parts on the requested structure.
Add weight where referrals are already open on the submission.
Done when a complexity score is recorded.
verify: Re-count the structural inputs on the submission.
Pass when the score follows from the counted inputs.

steps.title: Distinguish new business from renewal of a lost account
sop: Check the account history for a prior policy that lapsed or was lost.
Set the flag so the correct SLA applies to the item.
Done when the new-business flag reflects the account history.
verify: Compare the flag with the account policy history.
Pass when the flag matches the account history.

steps.title: Write the priority band to the submission
sop: Combine urgency, premium band, tier and complexity into the priority band.
Store the band on the submission header.
Done when a priority band is saved.
verify: Check that urgent-inception items sit above the lowest band.
Pass when no urgent item is in the lowest priority band.

steps.title: Derive the target quote date from the priority band
sop: Apply the SLA for the assigned band to the in-good-order date.
Write the derived target quote date to the submission.
Done when the target quote date is stored.
verify: Recompute the target date from the band SLA.
Pass when the stored date matches the recomputed date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prioritised submissions in the assignment queue awaiting an owning underwriter.

generic.Exception handling path: Authority or competency gaps returned to the UW Operations Manager for reassignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assigned underwriter recorded with assignment timestamp and assigner name.
generic.Evidence location: Assignment record on the policy admin submission and the underwriter worklist.

steps.title: Check the candidate authority against limit, premium and LOB
sop: Read the submission limit, estimated premium and line of business.
Compare with the candidate underwriter authority in the matrix.
Done when the authority check result is recorded.
verify: Re-read the candidate authority record.
Pass when the authority covers both limit and premium.

steps.title: Confirm specialty competency for the class
sop: Check the class against the competency register for the candidate.
Exclude candidates without the required accreditation for classes such as cyber.
Done when competency is confirmed for the chosen candidate.
verify: Open the competency register entry for the candidate.
Pass when the register shows the required accreditation.

steps.title: Check the candidate open workload and absence calendar
sop: Read the candidate open-submission count in the underwriting workstation.
Check the absence calendar for leave over the next working week.
Done when workload and availability are confirmed.
verify: Compare the open count with the desk ceiling.
Pass when the candidate is available and below the ceiling.

steps.title: Save the assignment with assigner, assignee and timestamp
sop: Set the assignee on the submission in the policy administration system.
Save so the assigner name and timestamp are captured.
Done when the assignment record is stored complete.
verify: Open the assignment record fields.
Pass when assignee, assigner and timestamp are all present.

steps.title: Notify the assignee in the worklist
sop: Confirm the submission appears in the assignee worklist.
Send the worklist notification if it did not fire automatically.
Done when the assignee has been notified.
verify: Open the assignee worklist view.
Pass when the submission is visible to the assignee.

steps.title: Obtain the assignee acknowledgement inside the acceptance window
sop: Open the assigned submission and review the risk and target quote date.
Acknowledge acceptance in the worklist within the acceptance window.
Done when the acknowledgement is recorded on the submission.
verify: Read the acknowledgement timestamp against the assignment timestamp.
Pass when acknowledgement occurred inside the acceptance window.

generic.Defined scope/population: All underwriters on the desk and their weighted open-submission workloads.
generic.In-scope period: Rebalancing performed on the current day against the next two weeks of capacity.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Weighted open count, aged item count and available capacity populated per underwriter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of per-underwriter open items equals total open submissions on the desk.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rebalancing decision and moved submissions recorded with the review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Underwriters left above the ceiling logged with the reason and the planned relief.
generic.Test population: All underwriters on the desk in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any underwriter exceeds the agreed weighted open-item ceiling after rebalancing.
generic.Exception handling path: Structural overload escalated to the Underwriting Director for resourcing action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Weighted open counts are published and refreshed for the current business day.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI workload dashboard and the workload review note in the workstation.

steps.title: Pull weighted open-submission counts from Power BI
sop: Open the workload dashboard sourced from the enterprise data warehouse.
Read weighted open counts rather than raw item counts.
Done when weighted counts for every underwriter are available.
verify: Check the dashboard refresh timestamp.
Pass when the data refreshed on the current business day.

steps.title: Count aged items over the SLA threshold separately
sop: Filter each underwriter list for items past the SLA threshold.
Record the aged count alongside the weighted open count.
Done when aged counts are recorded per underwriter.
verify: Compare aged counts with the aging report.
Pass when the two sources agree per underwriter.

steps.title: Apply planned leave, training and secondments to capacity
sop: Read the absence calendar for the next two weeks.
Reduce available capacity for each affected underwriter.
Done when adjusted capacity is recorded per underwriter.
verify: Compare the adjustment with the absence calendar entries.
Pass when every planned absence is reflected in capacity.

steps.title: Identify underwriters above the weighted ceiling
sop: Compare weighted open counts with the agreed maximum for the desk.
List every underwriter above the ceiling and the excess amount.
Done when the over-ceiling list is produced.
verify: Re-read the agreed ceiling value in force.
Pass when the comparison used the current agreed ceiling.

steps.title: Move submissions to bring every underwriter under the ceiling
sop: Select movable items that are not mid-negotiation with the broker.
Reassign them to underwriters with available weighted capacity.
Done when no underwriter remains above the ceiling.
verify: Refresh the workload dashboard after the moves.
Pass when every underwriter is at or below the ceiling.

steps.title: Record the rebalancing decision for the workload review
sop: Write the rebalancing note listing moved submissions and the reason.
File it against the desk workload review record.
Done when the note is filed for the review.
verify: Open the workload review record.
Pass when the note is present and lists the moved submissions.

generic.Defined scope/population: Newly assigned submissions where the underwriter needs broker and market context before acting.
generic.In-scope period: Briefing delivered on or before the underwriter first action on the submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker hit ratio, premium volume, loss performance and prior outcomes all stated in the note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Briefing notes filed equal assignments made in the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Briefing note saved to the submission file with author and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing broker data logged with the source gap and the date it will be available.
generic.Test population: All assignments made in the review period requiring a briefing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a briefing note is dated after the underwriter first recorded action.
generic.Exception handling path: Service issues on the broker relationship escalated to the UW Operations Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A written briefing note exists on the submission dated before first underwriter action.
generic.Evidence location: Briefing note on the submission file and the broker performance view in CRM.

steps.title: Pull broker hit ratio, volume and loss performance from CRM
sop: Open the broker account performance view in CRM.
Read hit ratio, written premium volume and loss ratio to date.
Done when the three performance measures are captured.
verify: Compare the figures with the current broker scorecard.
Pass when the captured figures match the scorecard.

steps.title: Surface prior submissions and declinations for this insured
sop: Search the account for prior submissions and their outcomes.
Note any prior declination and the reason code recorded.
Done when prior outcomes for the insured are listed.
verify: Compare the list with the account submission history.
Pass when every prior submission for the insured is listed.

steps.title: Record incumbent carrier, expiring terms and target price
sop: Read the broker submission for incumbent carrier and expiring terms.
Note the broker stated target price where it has been supplied.
Done when incumbent, expiring terms and target price are recorded or marked unknown.
verify: Compare the note with the broker covering message.
Pass when the note reflects what the broker actually supplied.

steps.title: Flag service issues and outstanding commitments
sop: Review open service complaints and commitments on the broker relationship.
Flag any that the assigned underwriter must honour or handle.
Done when open service items are flagged in the briefing.
verify: Compare the flags with the open service item list in CRM.
Pass when no open service item is missing from the briefing.

steps.title: Save the briefing note to the submission file
sop: Write the briefing note combining performance, history and service context.
Save it to the submission file and reference it on the assignment activity.
Done when the note is filed and linked to the assignment.
verify: Open the assignment activity and follow the link.
Pass when the briefing note opens from the assignment activity.

steps.title: Deliver the briefing to the assigned underwriter
sop: Read the briefing note before taking the first action on the submission.
Raise any question by Microsoft Teams or email before contacting the broker.
Done when the underwriter records having read the briefing.
verify: Compare the briefing read date with the first underwriter action date.
Pass when the briefing was read before the first action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Newly assigned submissions where account ownership and broker of record must be confirmed.
generic.In-scope period: Confirmation performed at assignment before the underwriter contacts the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Owning underwriter, servicing team, broker of record and territory alignment all recorded.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ownership conflicts logged with the coordination agreed between the underwriters.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a conflicting broker of record remains unresolved at the point of assignment.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved broker of record disputes referred to the UW Operations Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Owning underwriter and broker of record are populated and consistent with the assignment.
generic.Evidence location: Account contact panel in CRM and the ownership fields on the policy admin submission.

steps.title: Read the existing owning underwriter and servicing team on the account
sop: Open the account record in CRM and read the ownership panel.
Note the current owning underwriter and servicing team.
Done when existing ownership is known before any change.
verify: Compare the ownership panel with the policy admin account record.
Pass when both systems show the same existing owner.

steps.title: Match the producing broker with the broker of record
sop: Read the broker of record held on the account.
Compare with the producing broker on this submission.
Done when the comparison result is recorded.
verify: Re-read both broker values.
Pass when the recorded comparison matches the source values.

steps.title: Agree coordination where another underwriter owns other lines
sop: Identify other lines for the same insured owned by a different underwriter.
Agree who leads on client contact and note it on the account.
Done when the coordination agreement is recorded.
verify: Open the account note for the coordination agreement.
Pass when the agreement names both underwriters and the lead.

steps.title: Confirm territory and segment alignment
sop: Check the broker territory and segment against the assigned underwriter patch.
Reassign where the broker would face an unfamiliar contact.
Done when territory alignment is confirmed or corrected.
verify: Compare the broker territory with the underwriter patch definition.
Pass when the assignment sits inside the underwriter patch.

steps.title: Record the ownership confirmation on the submission
sop: Write the ownership confirmation on the submission with your name and date.
State the broker of record position confirmed.
Done when the confirmation is stored on the submission.
verify: Re-open the submission ownership field.
Pass when a dated ownership confirmation is present.

steps.title: Update the account contact panel in CRM
sop: Set the owning underwriter and servicing contacts on the account panel.
Remove contacts that no longer service the account.
Done when the contact panel matches the confirmed ownership.
verify: Compare the CRM panel with the submission ownership field.
Pass when both records show the same owning underwriter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assigned submissions that require an underwriting document file to be created.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Underwriting files created equal submissions assigned in the same period.

generic.Exception handling path: Access or retention setup problems referred to the New Business Case Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Folder is named with the submission reference and holds the standard sub-folder structure.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText folder properties and the folder link on the policy admin submission.

steps.title: Create the folder named with reference and named insured
sop: Create the underwriting file in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Name it with the submission reference followed by the named insured.
Done when the folder exists with the correct name.
verify: Search OpenText on the submission reference.
Pass when the search returns exactly one matching folder.

steps.title: Instantiate the standard sub-folder set
sop: Apply the underwriting file template to create the sub-folders.
Confirm application, exposure data, loss history, screening, correspondence and decisions exist.
Done when all six standard sub-folders are present.
verify: List the sub-folders in the new file.
Pass when the six standard sub-folders are all present.

steps.title: Link the folder from the submission record
sop: Add the folder link to the submission in the policy administration system.
Test the link opens the folder from the underwriting workstation.
Done when the link opens the folder in one click.
verify: Click the link from the submission record.
Pass when the correct folder opens directly.

steps.title: Set the retention class for underwriting files
sop: Apply the underwriting file retention class to the folder.
Do not leave the folder on the system default class.
Done when the retention class is set explicitly.
verify: Open folder properties and read the retention class.
Pass when a specific underwriting retention class is applied.

steps.title: Restrict access to underwriting and support groups
sop: Set the access group to the underwriting team and needed support functions.
Remove any broad or default all-staff access.
Done when access is limited to the intended groups.
verify: Open the folder permissions list.
Pass when no all-staff or default group holds access.

steps.title: Confirm the file is ready to receive documents
sop: Review folder name, structure, retention and access.
Correct any element before documents are filed into it.
Done when the file passes the readiness review.
verify: Re-check all four setup elements after any correction.
Pass when name, structure, retention and access are all correct.

generic.Defined scope/population: All received documents and screening outputs belonging to the assigned submission.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any document is left unclassified or keeps a raw scanner filename.
generic.Exception handling path: Unclassifiable documents referred to the New Business Case Manager for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Application, loss runs, screening output and correspondence each present under their type.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText underwriting file sub-folders and the document index for the submission.

steps.title: File application, SOV, loss runs and supplements to their sub-folders
sop: Move the application and exposure documents into the application and exposure sub-folders.
File loss runs into the loss history sub-folder and supplements with the application.
Done when each core document sits in its designated sub-folder.
verify: Open each sub-folder and list its contents.
Pass when every core document is in its designated location.

steps.title: File screening and clearance evidence to the screening sub-folder
sop: Save the sanctions and watchlist case output to the screening sub-folder.
Add the clearance record evidence alongside it.
Done when screening and clearance evidence are both filed.
verify: Open the screening sub-folder.
Pass when both screening output and clearance evidence are present.

steps.title: File third-party reports with their vendor reference ids
sop: Save loss history, credit and public-record reports to the file.
Record the vendor reference id on each index entry.
Done when every third-party report carries its vendor reference.
verify: Read the index entries for the filed reports.
Pass when each report shows a vendor reference id.

steps.title: File broker correspondence including acknowledgment and NIGO notices
sop: Move the acknowledgment, NIGO notices and broker replies to the correspondence sub-folder.
Keep the sent timestamps visible on each filed item.
Done when the correspondence sub-folder holds the full exchange.
verify: Compare the sub-folder contents with the CRM activity list.
Pass when every logged communication is also filed.

steps.title: Clean the document index of unclassified and scanner filenames
sop: Filter the index for documents typed as unclassified.
Set a proper type and rename any raw scanner filename.
Done when no unclassified item or scanner filename remains.
verify: Re-run the unclassified filter and scan the filenames.
Pass when the filter is empty and filenames are meaningful.

steps.title: Review the completed file before handover to underwriting
sop: Walk the sub-folders and confirm each expected document type is present.
Raise a gap note for anything missing before handover.
Done when the file is confirmed complete or gaps are noted.
verify: Compare the file contents with the completeness checklist.
Pass when every present checklist item has a filed document.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assigned submissions past the stale threshold with no recent underwriter activity.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Root cause, reassignment reason code, outgoing and incoming underwriter all recorded.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items left in place logged with the blocker and the date it is expected to clear.
generic.Test population: All submissions past the stale threshold in the review period.

generic.Exception handling path: Repeated staleness on the same desk escalated to the Underwriting Director.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each reassignment carries a reason code and outgoing and incoming underwriter names.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI aging report and the reassignment activity on the policy admin submission.

steps.title: Filter the aging report for stale submissions
sop: Open the Power BI aging report for the desk.
Filter to items past the SLA threshold with no activity in the defined period.
Done when the stale list for today is produced.
verify: Check the report refresh timestamp.
Pass when the list is built from current-day data.

steps.title: Check the root cause before moving anything

Done when every stale item carries a root cause.
verify: Compare the causes with the submission activity trails.

steps.title: Exclude items blocked on broker information

verify: Check each excluded item has an open diary.
Pass when every excluded item has an open chase diary.

steps.title: Execute the reassignment with a reason note
sop: Reassign each remaining stale item to an underwriter with capacity and authority.
Record the reason code and the note on the submission.
Done when every moved item carries a reason and a new owner.
verify: Open the reassignment records for the moved items.
Pass when reason code and both underwriter names are recorded.

steps.title: Notify the outgoing underwriter and the broker where in dialogue
sop: Tell the outgoing underwriter which items have moved and why.
Tell the broker the new underwriting contact where the account is in dialogue.
Done when both notifications are sent and filed.
verify: Open the correspondence log for the notification messages.
Pass when both notifications are on file with dates.

steps.title: Confirm no stale item remains without action or blocker
sop: Re-run the stale filter after the reassignments.
Confirm every remaining item has a documented blocker.
Done when the stale list is clear of unaddressed items.
verify: Read the blocker note on each remaining item.
Pass when every remaining stale item has a documented blocker.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assigned submissions that need a target quote date derived from broker deadline and SLA.
generic.In-scope period: Target set at assignment and revised whenever the underlying dates change.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Broker deadline, requested inception, internal SLA date and target quote date all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned submissions equal submissions carrying a target quote date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Target quote date stored on the header with the date it was set or changed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Target changes logged with the reason and evidence the broker was re-advised.
generic.Test population: All assigned submissions in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assigned submission has a blank target quote date.
generic.Exception handling path: Targets that cannot meet the SLA escalated to the UW Operations Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Target quote date is no later than the internal SLA allows from the in-good-order date.
generic.Evidence location: Submission header in the policy admin system and the CRM opportunity record.

steps.title: Capture the broker stated deadline and requested inception
sop: Read the broker covering message for a stated deadline.
Read the requested inception date from the submission header.
Done when both dates are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded dates with the broker message and header.
Pass when both dates match their sources.

steps.title: Apply the internal SLA to the in-good-order date

Done when the internal SLA date is calculated.
verify: Recompute the SLA date using the working-day calendar.
Pass when the calculated date matches the recomputation.

Select the earlier of the two as the working target.

verify: Re-read both candidate dates.
Pass when the chosen target is the earlier of the two.

Adjust the target where these cannot complete by the chosen date.
Done when the target reflects the dependency lead times.
verify: Compare the target with the longest dependency lead time.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open submissions on the desk shown by age bucket from the received date.

steps.title: Review the age buckets measured from received date

steps.title: Review items within two days of target with the owning underwriter

Pass when every near-target item has a recorded action.

Raise escalation or reassignment for each on the same day.

verify: Compare the past-target list with raised actions.
Pass when no past-target item is left without an action.

steps.title: Separate NIGO-held items from underwriting delay

Exclude them from the underwriting delay measure for the day.
Done when NIGO items are reported separately.
verify: Check the NIGO view against the submission statuses.

steps.title: Record the daily review outcome for the service scorecard

File it against the weekly service scorecard record.
Done when the daily note is filed.
verify: Open the scorecard record for the current week.
Pass when a note exists for each business day reviewed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved quotes ready for written release to the producing broker.
generic.In-scope period: Issued after quote approval and before the quote expiry date lapses.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quote corrections after issue logged as a new version with the reason recorded.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a quote was released while a mandatory referral or approval remained open.
generic.Exception handling path: Quotes needing terms outside authority held for Senior Underwriter approval before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quote shows limits, premium, subjectivities and an expiry date consistent with inception.
generic.Evidence location: Quote document in OpenText and the quote record in the Broker & Agent Portal.

steps.title: Generate the quote document from the rated record
sop: Produce the quote document from the policy administration system.
Do not retype limits, deductibles or premium into a free-form letter.
Done when a system-generated quote document exists.
verify: Compare the quote figures with the rated record.
Pass when limits, deductibles and premium match exactly.

steps.title: List every subjectivity explicitly
sop: List signed application, satisfactory survey, loss runs and premium payment terms as applicable.
Write each subjectivity as a separate numbered item.
Done when every subjectivity appears as its own line.
verify: Compare the list with the underwriting file conditions.
Pass when no agreed subjectivity is missing from the quote.

steps.title: State the quote validity and expiry date

State the expiry prominently in the quote body.

verify: Compare the expiry with the requested inception date.
Pass when the expiry is consistent with the inception date.

steps.title: Call out mandatory exclusions and coverage restrictions
sop: Bring mandatory exclusions and material restrictions into the quote body.
Do not leave them only in the attached form schedule.
Done when the restrictions are visible in the quote body.
verify: Read the quote body against the form schedule.
Pass when every material restriction appears in the body.

steps.title: Confirm no referral or authority approval remains open
sop: List open referrals and authority approvals on the submission.
Hold the release until each is closed or approved.
Done when no mandatory referral or approval is open.
verify: Re-run the open referral filter on the submission.
Pass when the filter returns nothing before release.

steps.title: Issue the quote through the portal and file the sent copy
sop: Send the quote through the Broker & Agent Portal to the contact of record.
File the sent copy to the submission in OpenText with its send timestamp.
Done when the quote is sent and the copy is filed.
verify: Open the filed copy and the portal message record.
Pass when the quote is visible to the broker and filed with a timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Producing broker, agency and any surplus lines broker on submissions heading toward binding.
generic.In-scope period: Verification performed before binding and refreshed when the state set changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Licence status, lines of authority, appointment status and verification date all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States verified equal states of exposure on the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: NIPR verification result stored with source and date on the producer record.

generic.Exception handling path: Licensing gaps referred to the Producer Compliance Manager before binding proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Active licence and company appointment confirmed for every state of exposure.
generic.Evidence location: NIPR verification record and the producer panel on the policy admin submission.

steps.title: List the states of exposure requiring producer licensing

Build the list of states where the producer must be licensed.

verify: Compare the list with the eligibility conclusions per state.
Pass when the two lists agree.

steps.title: Check producer licence status and lines of authority in NIPR
sop: Look up the producer in NIPR for each state on the list.
Confirm the licence is active and carries the correct lines of authority.

verify: Re-read two state results directly in NIPR.
Pass when the sampled results match what was recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the appointment with the writing company is active

Flag any appointment shown as terminated or lapsed.

verify: Compare appointment status with the company appointment register.
Pass when both sources show the same appointment status.

steps.title: Check the agency licence where the state requires both
sop: Identify states requiring an agency licence in addition to the individual.
Verify the agency licence is active in each such state.
Done when agency licences are verified where required.
verify: Compare the states checked with the agency-licence requirement list.
Pass when every state requiring an agency licence has been checked.

steps.title: Verify the surplus lines broker licence for non-admitted placements
sop: Where the placement is non-admitted, identify the surplus lines broker.
Verify their surplus lines licence is active in the relevant state.
Done when the surplus lines licence is verified or ruled not applicable.
verify: Compare the licence check with the non-admitted placement route.
Pass when every non-admitted state has a verified surplus lines licence.

steps.title: Record the verification date, source and result
sop: Write the verification date, source and result on the producer record.
Reference the verification from the submission producer panel.
Done when the verification is recorded and referenced.
verify: Open the submission producer panel and follow the reference.
Pass when the dated verification result opens from the submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions arriving through coverholder or binding authority channels for this binder.

generic.Evidence location: Binder file for the coverholder and the delegated authority block on the submission.

steps.title: Confirm the binder agreement is in force and in date

Confirm the binder is in force at the requested inception date.
Done when the binder in-force position is confirmed.
verify: Compare the binder period with the requested inception date.

verify: Re-read the binder class schedule.

steps.title: Test territory and limit against the binder authority
sop: Compare the states of exposure with the binder territory schedule.
Compare the requested limit with the binder limit authority.
Done when both territory and limit tests are recorded.
verify: Re-read the binder territory and limit clauses.
Pass when the risk sits inside both territory and limit authority.

steps.title: Refer out-of-authority risks to the open-market desk
sop: Identify risks failing any binder authority test.
Raise a referral to the open-market desk rather than allowing a bind.
Done when every out-of-authority risk is referred.
verify: Compare failed tests with raised referrals.
Pass when no out-of-authority risk was left with the coverholder.

steps.title: Confirm bordereau reporting expectations and cut-off
sop: Confirm the bordereau format and reporting cut-off with the coverholder.
Note the period in which this risk must be reported.
Done when the reporting expectation for this risk is confirmed.
verify: Compare the confirmed cut-off with the binder reporting clause.
Pass when the cut-off matches the binder requirement.

steps.title: Record the coordination outcome on submission and binder file
sop: Write the outcome on the submission delegated authority block.
Mirror the entry against the coverholder binder file.
Done when both records carry the coordination outcome.
verify: Open both records and compare the entries.
Pass when submission and binder file show the same outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Broker negotiations where the ask falls outside pricing or coverage guidelines.

generic.Evidence location: Escalation record in the underwriting workstation and the CRM opportunity activity.

steps.title: Identify the escalation trigger explicitly

Record the trigger on the escalation record.

Done when the impact is quantified in the escalation note.
verify: Recalculate the premium difference from the two positions.
Pass when the stated impact matches the recalculation.

steps.title: State the underwriter recommendation

Support it with one line of reasoning.
Done when a single recommendation is recorded.
verify: Read the recommendation against the impact figures.
Pass when the recommendation follows from the stated impact.

steps.title: Route the escalation with any exception request attached
sop: Send the escalation to the underwriting manager through the workstation.
Attach any pricing or appetite exception request that the ask requires.
Done when the escalation and attachments are with the manager.
verify: Open the manager queue and locate the escalation.
Pass when the escalation and its attachments are visible to the manager.

steps.title: Record the management decision before answering the broker

Done when the decision and conditions are stored.
verify: Compare the decision timestamp with the broker reply timestamp.
Pass when the decision was recorded before the broker was answered.

generic.Defined scope/population: Portal items past their SLA due date across broker-owned and underwriting-owned delays.

Tag each item as broker owned or underwriting owned.

sop: Raise an escalation on each underwriting-owned overdue item.
Name the owning underwriter and set a next-action date.

sop: Send a portal chase restating the specific outstanding requirement.

Pass when each broker-owned item shows a dated chase.

Pass when unresolved items have moved to the manager.

verify: Search the submission activity list for the known email exchanges.

Pass when every call or meeting has a matching note.

Pass when the recorded wording matches what was said.

Pass when every logged activity has a filed document where one exists.

sop: Read the activity log end to end before issuing terms.

verify: Check the log covers every stage from acknowledgment to current position.

Log the message in CRM against the submission.

Pass when no pre-quote message confirms firm terms or coverage.

sop: Filter the portal for items showing received with no matching submission record.

Raise escalations to the owning underwriters for items still past target.
