generic.Required fields populated and valid: Item name, reason, response-by date and matching requirement line for each gap.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items on the request equal open requirement lines raised on the submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request message stored in CRM and the portal with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items dropped from the request after review logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All information requests issued in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any requested item lacks a discrete requirement line or a response-by date.
generic.Exception handling path: Broker pushback on an item referred to the Underwriter for a necessity ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Follow-up diary exists dated on or before the stated response-by date.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal request message and the requirements panel on the submission.

steps.title: Consolidate all identified gaps into a single request
sop: Collect every gap identified by the underwriter and the completeness review.
Combine them into one request rather than sending piecemeal notes.
Done when a single consolidated gap list exists.
verify: Compare the list with the underwriter notes and the checklist.
Pass when no known gap is left off the list.

steps.title: Name each item precisely enough to action
sop: Write each item with its exact scope such as five years currently-valued GL loss runs.
Avoid generic phrasing such as loss information.
Done when every item is specific and actionable.
verify: Read each line and judge whether a broker could act without calling.
Pass when every line is actionable as written.

steps.title: Give the reason for each requested item
sop: Add a short reason per item so the broker can explain it to the insured.
Tie the reason to the underwriting decision it supports.
Done when every item carries a reason.
verify: Check each item line for a reason.
Pass when no item is listed without a reason.

steps.title: Set the response-by date against target quote and inception
sop: Choose a response-by date that still allows the target quote date to be met.
Confirm it falls before the requested inception date.
Done when the response-by date is set and consistent.
verify: Compare the date with target quote and inception dates.
Pass when the date supports both downstream dates.

steps.title: Raise each item as an open requirement line
sop: Create a discrete requirement line in the policy admin system per requested item.
Set the response-by date on each requirement.
Done when requirement lines match the requested items one for one.
verify: Count requirement lines against requested items.
Pass when the counts are equal.

steps.title: Send the request and set the follow-up diary
sop: Send the request through the Broker & Agent Portal and log it in CRM.
Set a follow-up diary dated on or before the response-by date.
Done when the request is sent and the diary is set.
verify: Compare the diary due date with the stated response-by date.
Pass when a diary exists dated on or before that date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound broker status inquiries arriving by email, portal or phone.
generic.In-scope period: Answered within 4 working hours for email and the same day for portal messages.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Current stage, outstanding items and expected next milestone date stated in the reply.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Responses logged equal inbound inquiries logged for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Response filed against the submission with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Inquiries answered late logged with the cause and the eventual response time.
generic.Test population: All inbound broker inquiries received in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any inquiry response exceeds the published response-time standard.
generic.Exception handling path: Inquiries needing an underwriter answer receive an interim reply with a commitment date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each inbound inquiry has a logged response inside the published standard.
generic.Evidence location: CRM activity on the broker contact and the Broker & Agent Portal message thread.

steps.title: Pick up the inquiry and start the response clock
sop: Open the inquiry in CRM, the portal or the shared mailbox.
Log the receipt time so the response standard can be measured.
Done when the inquiry is logged with its receipt time.
verify: Compare the logged receipt time with the message header.
Pass when the logged time matches the message header.

steps.title: Read the current stage and outstanding items on the submission
sop: Open the submission and read its status and open requirements.
Note the next milestone and its expected date.
Done when the current position is understood.
verify: Compare the noted position with the submission header.
Pass when the noted position matches the record.

steps.title: Draft the reply stating stage, outstanding items and next milestone
sop: Write the reply covering the current stage and what remains outstanding.
Give the expected next milestone date.
Done when all three elements are in the draft.
verify: Read the draft for stage, outstanding items and milestone date.
Pass when all three elements are present.

steps.title: Send an interim reply where the underwriter must answer
sop: Where the answer needs underwriting input, send an interim reply immediately.
Give a commitment date for the full answer rather than staying silent.
Done when the broker has an interim reply with a commitment date.
verify: Compare the interim reply time with the receipt time.
Pass when the interim reply was sent inside the standard.

steps.title: Mirror any commitment as a diary action
sop: Create a diary for every commitment date given in the reply.
Assign it to the owning queue so it is actually met.
Done when each commitment has a diary action.
verify: Compare commitments in the reply with open diaries.
Pass when every commitment has a matching diary.

steps.title: File the response and refresh the portal status
sop: File the response against the submission in CRM.
Update the portal status so it matches what the broker was told.
Done when the response is filed and the portal status matches.
verify: Compare the portal status with the answer given.
Pass when the portal reflects what the broker was told.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closed declination files requiring archive for regulatory and audit retrieval.
generic.In-scope period: Archived once the declination file is closed and the notice has been issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Screening output, clearance record, decision, notice and retention class all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived declination files equal declinations closed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice as issued archived with its sent timestamp alongside the decision record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files archived with a missing artefact logged and completed before sign-off.
generic.Test population: All declination files archived in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any archived declination file carries a default or blank retention class.
generic.Exception handling path: Retention class disputes referred to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Screening output, clearance, decision and issued notice all present with a retention class.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText archive folder for the declination and the Archer GRC retention register.

steps.title: Confirm screening output and hit dispositions are in the file
sop: Open the screening sub-folder in the declination file.
Confirm the case output and every hit disposition are present.
Done when screening evidence is complete in the file.
verify: Compare the filed dispositions with the screening case record.
Pass when every disposition in the case is filed.

steps.title: Confirm clearance, appetite decision and approval evidence
sop: Add the clearance record, appetite decision and declination approval to the archive set.
Check the approval names the approver and the authority level.
Done when all three artefacts are in the archive set.
verify: List the archive set contents.
Pass when clearance, decision and approval are all present.

steps.title: Archive the issued notice with its sent timestamp
sop: Add the declination notice as issued to the archive set.
Confirm the sent timestamp is preserved on the archived copy.
Done when the notice and its timestamp are archived.
verify: Open the archived notice and read the timestamp.
Pass when the archived notice shows its original sent timestamp.

steps.title: Set the retention class to the longest applicable period
sop: Compare sanctions recordkeeping retention with general underwriting retention.
Apply the longer of the two to the archived file.
Done when the longest applicable retention class is applied.
verify: Open folder properties and read the retention class.
Pass when the applied class is the longest applicable and not a default.

steps.title: Index the archive for regulator retrieval
sop: Index the archived file by insured name, FEIN, submission reference and declination date.
Test retrieval on each of the four index keys.
Done when the file is retrievable on all four keys.
verify: Search the archive on FEIN and on declination date.
Pass when both searches return the archived file.

steps.title: Register the archive in Archer GRC
sop: Record the archived declination in the GRC retention register.
Link the register entry to the OpenText archive location.
Done when the register entry exists and links to the file.
verify: Open the register entry and follow the link.
Pass when the link opens the archived declination file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Declined submissions ready to be closed with a complete documentation trail.
generic.In-scope period: Closure performed once the declination notice has been issued and delivered.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason code, rationale, approver, issued notice and closure status all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed declinations equal issued declination notices for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice and its delivery evidence attached to the file with timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files reopened after closure logged with the reason and the reopening approval.
generic.Test population: All declination files closed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open diary, requirement or referral remains on a closed declination file.
generic.Exception handling path: Open referrals at closure returned to the Underwriter to close or cancel with a reason.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure status reads Declined with reason code, rationale, approver and notice attached.
generic.Evidence location: Closed submission record in the policy admin system and the OpenText declination file.

steps.title: Confirm reason code, rationale and approver are present
sop: Open the declination decision record on the submission.
Confirm reason code, rationale text and approver name are all populated.
Done when the decision record is complete.
verify: Re-read the three decision fields.
Pass when none of the three is blank.

steps.title: Attach the issued notice and its delivery evidence
sop: Attach the issued declination notice to the file.
Add the delivery evidence showing method and timestamp.
Done when notice and delivery evidence are both attached.
verify: Open the attached notice and delivery evidence.
Pass when both open and show a delivery timestamp.

steps.title: Close or cancel outstanding diaries and requirements
sop: List open diaries and requirements on the submission.
Close or cancel each with a reason before closure.
Done when no diary or requirement remains open.
verify: Re-run the open diary and requirement filters.
Pass when both filters return nothing.

steps.title: Close or cancel open referrals
sop: List open referrals including specialty and reinsurance referrals.
Close each with the outcome or cancel it with a reason.
Done when no referral remains open on the file.
verify: Re-run the open referral filter.
Pass when no referral remains open.

steps.title: Set closure status to Declined
sop: Set the closure status to Declined rather than Lapsed or Not Taken Up.
Confirm the status feeds the declination MI dataset.
Done when the status reads Declined.
verify: Read the closure status on the submission header.
Pass when the status is Declined and not another closure code.

steps.title: Leave the policy shell in a non-bindable state
sop: Confirm the policy shell and any draft rating worksheets cannot be issued.
Withdraw or void any draft quote left on the job.
Done when nothing on the file can be bound in error.
verify: Attempt to progress the job to bind.
Pass when the system prevents binding on the closed file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions with a provisional decline that need the final position confirmed and locked.
generic.In-scope period: Confirmation made after all referrals close and before the formal notice is drafted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Confirming underwriter, authority level, date and final position all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Final positions confirmed equal provisional declines progressing to notice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Final position dated and locked on the submission decision record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Positions changed after new information logged with the reviewed evidence.
generic.Test population: All declination positions confirmed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any referral remains open when the final declination position is confirmed.
generic.Exception handling path: Positions outside the confirming underwriter authority passed to the Senior Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Final position recorded with confirming underwriter, date and authority level.
generic.Evidence location: Declination decision record on the policy admin submission and the referral list.

steps.title: Review information received since the provisional decision
sop: List documents and data received after the provisional decline.
Assess whether any of it changes the underwriting conclusion.
Done when the late information has been assessed.
verify: Compare the assessment with the file received-date order.
Pass when every later document has been considered.

steps.title: Confirm open referrals are closed or incorporated
sop: List open referrals and specialty desk opinions.
Close each or write its conclusion into the final position.
Done when no referral is left unresolved.
verify: Re-run the open referral filter.
Pass when the filter returns nothing.

steps.title: Rule out counter-offer and hold explicitly
sop: Consider a restructured counter-offer and a hold pending information.
Record why each alternative is not being taken.
Done when both alternatives are explicitly ruled out.
verify: Read the reasoning for each ruled-out alternative.
Pass when both alternatives carry a recorded reason.

steps.title: Confirm the position at the correct authority level
sop: Check the risk size and class against the authority matrix.
Confirm the position is being recorded by someone holding that authority.
Done when the confirming person holds the required authority.
verify: Compare the confirming user authority with the matrix requirement.
Pass when the authority level is sufficient for the risk.

steps.title: Record the final position with name and date
sop: Write the final position of decline on the decision record.
Save so the confirming name and date are stamped.
Done when the final position carries name and date.
verify: Open the decision record fields.
Pass when name, date and authority level are all present.

steps.title: Lock the position before the notice is drafted
sop: Lock the decision record so it cannot be edited without a new approval.
Release the submission to the notice drafting step.
Done when the position is locked and the notice step is open.
verify: Attempt to edit the locked decision record.
Pass when the record cannot be edited without approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Declined submissions requiring a documented basis against guidelines and state regulation.
generic.In-scope period: Basis determined before the declination approval is sought and the notice drafted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Guideline section, class or no-write entry, model factors and adverse-action route recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented bases equal declination decisions taken in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Basis stored on the declination record with author, date and guideline version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bases rewritten after compliance review logged with the original and revised wording.
generic.Test population: All declination bases documented in the review period across rating states.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any basis references a prohibited or protected characteristic.
generic.Exception handling path: Doubtful wording referred to the Compliance Analyst before the basis is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Basis cites the specific guideline, class or rule supporting the declination.
generic.Evidence location: Declination basis field on the policy admin submission and the guideline version referenced.

steps.title: Cite the guideline, class or no-write entry relied on
sop: Identify the guideline section, class code or no-write list entry that supports the decline.
Write the citation into the basis field on the submission.
Done when a specific citation is recorded.
verify: Open the cited guideline section and read it.
Pass when the cited text supports the declination.

steps.title: Document model or score factors where one contributed
sop: List the factors the model or score contributed to the decision.
Record the human judgement applied so the decision is not solely automated.
Done when model factors and human judgement are both documented.
verify: Read the basis for evidence of human review.
Pass when the decision is not recorded as solely automated.

steps.title: Test the basis against prohibited underwriting factors
sop: Compare the basis wording with the prohibited factor list for the rating state.
Reject any basis touching a protected characteristic.
Done when the basis is confirmed free of prohibited factors.
verify: Re-read the basis against the prohibited factor list.
Pass when no prohibited or protected characteristic appears.

steps.title: Identify the adverse-action pathway where a consumer report was used
sop: Check whether a consumer report contributed to the declination.
Where it did, record that adverse-action content is required in the notice.
Done when the adverse-action requirement is determined.
verify: Compare the finding with the third-party reports on the file.
Pass when the adverse-action flag matches the reports used.

steps.title: Write the basis in plain factual terms
sop: Rewrite the basis so it can be repeated to a broker or regulator unchanged.
Remove internal jargon, scoring detail and speculation.
Done when the basis is plain, factual and repeatable.
verify: Read the basis aloud as if to a regulator.
Pass when it needs no rewording to be shared externally.

steps.title: Record the basis on the declination record
sop: Review the basis for accuracy and sufficiency.
Save it to the declination record with the guideline version cited.
Done when the basis is stored and reviewed.
verify: Open the declination record and read the stored basis.
Pass when the basis is present with a guideline citation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Confirmed declinations requiring a formal compliant notice to broker and applicant.
generic.In-scope period: Notice issued within 24 hours of the final declination position being confirmed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State template, statutory language, adverse-action content and addressees all correct.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices issued equal confirmed final declination positions for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent copy, delivery method and timestamp filed to the submission before closure.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices returned undelivered logged with the resend method and delivery date.
generic.Test population: All declination notices issued in the review period across rating states.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a consumer report was used and the notice lacks CRA and dispute-rights language.
generic.Exception handling path: Template or statutory wording doubts referred to the Compliance Analyst before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice on the current state template filed with a sent timestamp inside 24 hours.
generic.Evidence location: Notice document in OpenText and the issued notice record in the broker portal.

steps.title: Select the state-specific declination template
sop: Identify the rating state on the submission.
Select the current declination template for that state.
Done when the correct current template is loaded.
verify: Compare the template version with the published current version.
Pass when the current state template is in use.

steps.title: Keep required statutory language intact
sop: Read the statutory paragraphs in the template.
Confirm none has been edited, shortened or removed.
Done when statutory language is confirmed intact.
verify: Compare the notice statutory text with the template source.
Pass when the statutory text matches the template exactly.

steps.title: Add adverse-action content where a consumer report was used
sop: Where a consumer report contributed, add the CRA name, address and phone.
Include the dispute-rights language required by the regulation.
Done when adverse-action content is complete or confirmed not required.
verify: Read the notice for CRA identification and dispute rights.
Pass when both are present wherever a consumer report was used.

steps.title: Address the notice to broker and applicant as the state requires
sop: Address the producing broker as standard.
Add the applicant as an addressee where the state requires applicant notification.
Done when the addressee set matches the state requirement.
verify: Compare the addressees with the state notification rule.
Pass when every required addressee is on the notice.

steps.title: Issue the notice within 24 hours of the confirmed position
sop: Send the notice through the Broker & Agent Portal and the required delivery method.
Capture the send timestamp on the submission.
Done when the notice is sent with a captured timestamp.
verify: Measure elapsed time from the confirmed position to the send timestamp.
Pass when the notice was issued within 24 hours.

steps.title: File the sent copy, delivery method and timestamp
sop: File the sent notice copy to the submission in OpenText.
Record the delivery method and timestamp alongside it.
Done when copy, method and timestamp are all filed.
verify: Open the filed copy and read the delivery record.
Pass when copy, method and timestamp are all retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Declinations requiring approval at the level set by premium, limit and account strategic status.
generic.In-scope period: Approval obtained before the declination notice is issued to the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Required level, approver name, authority level and approval timestamp all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approvals recorded equal declinations above the self-approval threshold.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval decision stored on the submission decision record with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approvals refused logged with the alternative action taken on the submission.
generic.Test population: All declinations recorded in the review period across premium bands.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a declination above the threshold was issued without second-person approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Approver unavailability routed to the Underwriting Director rather than self-approved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval exists with approver name, authority level and timestamp before the notice date.
generic.Evidence location: Approval record on the policy admin submission and the workflow block on notice issue.

steps.title: Derive the required approval level
sop: Read premium size, limit and whether the account is target or strategic.
Look up the required approval level in the authority matrix.
Done when the required level is identified.
verify: Re-run the matrix lookup for the same inputs.
Pass when the same required level is returned.

steps.title: Assemble the approval request content
sop: Attach the declination basis, exposure summary and broker relationship context.
State the requested decision clearly at the top of the request.
Done when the request carries all three elements.
verify: Read the request for basis, exposure and relationship context.
Pass when all three elements are present.

steps.title: Route to an approver who is not the recommending underwriter
sop: Select an approver at the required level who did not recommend the decline.
Route the request to that approver in the workflow.
Done when the request sits with an independent approver.
verify: Compare approver and recommender identities.
Pass when the two are different people above the threshold.

steps.title: Record the approval decision, name, level and timestamp
sop: Decide approve or refuse on the declination request.
Save so name, authority level and timestamp are captured.
Done when the approval record is complete.
verify: Open the approval record fields.
Pass when decision, name, level and timestamp are all present.

steps.title: Confirm the workflow blocks notice issue without approval
sop: Attempt to issue the notice with the approval absent.
Confirm the workflow prevents issue until the approval exists.
Done when the block is confirmed working.
verify: Repeat the attempt on a test submission without approval.
Pass when notice issue is blocked without an approval record.

steps.title: Check the approval date precedes the notice send date
sop: Compare the approval timestamp with the notice send timestamp.
Investigate any notice sent before its approval.
Done when the ordering is confirmed for every declination.
verify: Re-run the date comparison across the period sample.
Pass when every approval precedes its notice send date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Declined submissions where a restructured option or alternative market may be feasible.
generic.In-scope period: Alternatives considered at declination and communicated with the outcome message.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Options tested, alternative product checked, referral route and broker response recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Alternatives records equal declinations where alternatives were feasible.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Alternatives offered and the broker response stored on the declination record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Alternatives ruled out logged with the reason they are not feasible.
generic.Test population: All declinations in the review period where alternatives were considered.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an alternative is offered for a class or structure on the no-write list.
generic.Exception handling path: Uncertain in-house appetite checked with the Senior Underwriter before being suggested.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Alternatives considered and offered are recorded together with the broker response.
generic.Evidence location: Alternatives note on the declination record in CRM and the portal message thread.

steps.title: Test restructured options first
sop: Test a higher deductible, reduced limit or excluded location or coverage part.
Record whether any restructure brings the risk inside appetite.
Done when the restructure options are tested and recorded.
verify: Compare the tested options with the reason for decline.
Pass when the options tested address the actual decline driver.

steps.title: Check an alternative in-house product or writing company
sop: Check appetite for the risk under another in-house product or company.
Confirm appetite before anything is suggested to the broker.
Done when the in-house alternative is confirmed or ruled out.
verify: Read the appetite check result for the alternative product.
Pass when the alternative was checked before being offered.

steps.title: Mention surplus lines only where genuinely eligible
sop: Check surplus lines eligibility for the risk and state.
Mention the non-admitted route only where eligibility exists.
Done when the surplus lines position is established.
verify: Compare the mention with the eligibility conclusion on file.
Pass when surplus lines is mentioned only where eligible.

steps.title: Disclose external market referrals as signposts only
sop: Present any external market referral as a signpost.
Make no representation about their terms or willingness to accept.
Done when the referral wording carries no representation.
verify: Read the referral wording for any implied commitment.
Pass when no representation about external terms is made.

steps.title: Check no offered alternative sits on the no-write list
sop: Compare each alternative class or structure with the no-write list.
Withdraw any alternative that appears on it.
Done when no offered alternative is on the no-write list.
verify: Re-check the alternatives against the current no-write list.
Pass when none of the offered alternatives is prohibited.

steps.title: Record the alternatives offered and the broker response
sop: Write the alternatives offered onto the declination record.
Add the broker response when it arrives.
Done when offer and response are both recorded.
verify: Open the declination record alternatives section.
Pass when the offer and the broker response are both present.

generic.Defined scope/population: All declined submissions requiring reason coding for MI and appetite analytics.
generic.In-scope period: Coded at the point of declination before the file is closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Primary reason code, any secondary code, declined premium and class code populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Declination rows in the warehouse equal declinations closed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reason coding stored with the coder and timestamp on the declination record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Other reason codes logged with the free-text explanation that justifies them.
generic.Test population: All declination records created in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any declination row carries a null or Other code without free-text explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Codes inconsistent with the free-text basis referred to the Portfolio UW Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A controlled-list primary reason code is stored with declined premium and class code.
generic.Evidence location: Declination record in the policy admin system and the appetite dataset in the warehouse.

steps.title: Select the primary reason code from the standard list
sop: Choose from out of appetite, CAT exposure, loss history, price, capacity or incomplete information.
Select the code that best matches the documented basis.
Done when a controlled-list primary code is stored.
verify: Compare the code with the declination basis text.
Pass when the code matches the documented basis.

steps.title: Record a secondary contributing code where relevant
sop: Where more than one factor drove the decline, add the secondary code.
Leave it blank only where a single factor genuinely applies.
Done when the secondary code is set or deliberately blank.
verify: Read the basis for a second contributing factor.
Pass when a second factor in the basis has a secondary code.

steps.title: Cross-check the code against the free-text basis
sop: Read the code and the free-text basis side by side.
Correct whichever is wrong so MI and the file tell the same story.
Done when code and basis are consistent.
verify: Re-read both after any correction.
Pass when the code and the basis describe the same reason.

steps.title: Record the declined premium and class code
sop: Enter the estimated premium that was declined.
Enter the class code so declined-premium-by-class analysis is possible.
Done when premium and class code are both stored.
verify: Compare the stored values with the submission header.
Pass when premium and class code match the submission.

steps.title: Add free text wherever Other is used
sop: Where the code list has no fit, add a free-text explanation with the Other code.
Suggest a new code to the portfolio team where the case recurs.
Done when every Other code carries an explanation.
verify: Filter declinations coded Other for blank free text.
Pass when the filter returns nothing.

steps.title: Confirm the record flows to the appetite dataset
sop: Query the appetite dataset in the warehouse for the declination reference.
Raise a data issue where the record has not flowed through.
Done when the record is visible in the appetite dataset.
verify: Re-query the dataset after the next load.
Pass when the declination appears with its reason code and premium.

generic.Defined scope/population: Broker reconsideration requests raised against a recorded declination.
generic.In-scope period: Handled from receipt of the request until a written response is issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New information described, comparison with the original file, reviewer and outcome recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reconsideration entries equal reconsideration requests received in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request, review and outcome all stored on the original declination record with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reversals logged with the approval level that authorised them.
generic.Test population: All reconsideration requests received in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a declination was reversed without approval at or above the original level.
generic.Exception handling path: Material new information triggers a full re-screen rather than an informal reversal.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entry records the new information reviewed, the reviewer and the outcome.
generic.Evidence location: Reconsideration entry on the declination record and the portal response message.

steps.title: Identify the new information explicitly
sop: List what the broker has now supplied that was not on the file before.
Record it as the new information for the review.
Done when the new information is listed.
verify: Compare the list with the file contents at the original decision.
Pass when everything listed is genuinely new.

steps.title: Compare it with the file at the original decision
sop: Read the original basis and the evidence it relied on.
Judge whether the new information changes any of those facts.
Done when the comparison conclusion is recorded.
verify: Read the conclusion against the original basis.
Pass when the conclusion addresses the original decline driver.

steps.title: Uphold the decision plainly where nothing material is new
sop: Where nothing material has changed, uphold the original decision.
State that plainly to the broker without ambiguity.
Done when the upheld position is recorded and communicated.
verify: Read the response for a clear upheld statement.
Pass when the response leaves no ambiguity about the outcome.

steps.title: Re-screen appetite and eligibility for material new information
sop: Where the new information is material, re-run appetite and eligibility screening.
Do not wave the risk through on the strength of the request alone.
Done when a fresh screening result is recorded.
verify: Open the fresh screening record.
Pass when a new screening outcome exists dated after the request.

steps.title: Approve any reversal at the original authority level or above
sop: Check the authority level that made the original declination.
Approve any reversal at that level or higher and record it.
Done when the reversal approval is recorded at the right level.
verify: Compare the reversal approver level with the original approver level.
Pass when the reversal level is equal or higher.

steps.title: Record request, review and outcome on the declination record
sop: Write the request, the review performed and the outcome onto the original record.
File the response message sent to the broker.
Done when all three elements and the response are on file.
verify: Open the declination record reconsideration section.
Pass when request, review, outcome and response are all present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Declinations in states operating a FAIR plan, residual market or assigned-risk mechanism.
generic.In-scope period: Review completed before the declination file is closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State mechanism, permitted-reason test, applicant notification and reporting duty recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviews completed equal declinations in residual-market states for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Compliance conclusion stored with the state rule cited, the reviewer and the date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declinations found impermissible logged with the corrective action taken.
generic.Test population: All declinations in the review period in states with a residual market mechanism.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a declination in a residual-market state closed without the availability review.
generic.Exception handling path: Doubtful permitted-reason cases referred to the Compliance Analyst for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated compliance review cites the state rule and confirms the declination is permitted.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance review entry on the declination file and the Archer GRC obligation record.

steps.title: Check whether the rating state operates a residual market mechanism
sop: Identify the rating state and the line of business.
Check for a FAIR plan, residual market or assigned-risk mechanism covering it.
Done when the state mechanism position is established.
verify: Compare the finding with the residual market register.
Pass when the finding matches the register for that state and line.

steps.title: Test the declination reason against the state availability rules
sop: Read the state availability rules for permitted declination reasons.
Compare the recorded declination reason against them.
Done when the reason is confirmed permitted or challenged.
verify: Re-read the state rule cited against the reason.
Pass when the cited rule permits the recorded reason.

steps.title: Inform the applicant of the residual market route where required
sop: Where the state requires it, tell the applicant about the residual market route.
Explain how to access the mechanism in plain terms.
Done when the applicant notification is issued or ruled not required.
verify: Compare the notification with the state requirement.
Pass when notification was given wherever the state requires it.

steps.title: Identify any state declination reporting obligation
sop: Check for state-mandated declination reporting or recordkeeping duties.
Schedule the reporting where a duty exists.
Done when reporting duties are identified and scheduled.
verify: Open the scheduled obligation in Archer GRC.
Pass when every identified duty has a scheduled obligation.

steps.title: Record the compliance conclusion and the rule relied on
sop: Write the conclusion on the declination file with the state rule cited.
Name the reviewer and date the entry.
Done when conclusion, rule, reviewer and date are stored.
verify: Open the compliance entry on the declination file.
Pass when all four elements are present.

steps.title: Block closure until the availability review is complete
sop: Check residual-market state declinations for a completed availability review.
Hold closure on any file where the review is missing.
Done when no such file closes without the review.
verify: Filter closed declinations in residual-market states for missing reviews.
Pass when the filter returns nothing.
